title: An Act Concerning Absentee Voting For All And Various Other Reforms To The Administration Of Elections.

description: To establish (1) an estate tax recapture for certain estates, and (2) an alternative minimum estate tax to prevent the effective net tax rate from falling below two per cent.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of The Needs Of Senior Citizens.
description: To study the needs of senior citizens in the state in order to ensure the adequate allocation of resources.

title: An Act Requiring Fear Of Retaliation Training For Persons Providing Assisted Living Services In Managed Residential Communities.
description: To require assisted living services agencies that provide assisted living services in a managed residential community to provide annual in-service training to employees concerning residents' fear of retaliation from employees or others.

title: An Act Concerning The Use Of Technology For Virtual Visitation And Monitoring In Nursing Homes And Residential Care Homes.
description: To extend protections for the use of technology for the purpose of virtual monitoring and virtual visitation to residents of residential care homes and prescribe a penalty for violation of such protections.

title: An Act Requiring Training For Homemaker-companion Agency Employees.
description: To require homemaker-companion agencies to provide not less than ten hours of (1) initial training to new employees, and (2) continuing education to current employees.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For School Meals.
description: To provide funding to reimburse school districts for the difference between the federal reimbursement rate for reduced-price and fully paid school meals.

title: An Act Concerning The Department Of Economic And Community Development.
description: To require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to study economic development issues in the state.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of The Remediation And Development Of Brownfields In This State.
description: To require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to study issues related to the remediation and development of brownfields in the state.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Department Of Administrative Services Regarding The School Building Projects Statutes.
description: To cap the total reimbursement percentage a board of education may receive under the school building project grant program at one hundred per cent and to make revisions to the responsibilities of the School Building Projects Advisory Council to focus on school safety.

title: An Act Concerning Schools.
description: To require the Department of Education to study schools.

title: An Act Concerning Phone-free Schools.
description: To limit the use of cell phones during the school day and to prohibit school districts from using social media as the only means of providing information to families.

title: An Act Concerning Authorization Of State Grant Commitments For School Building Projects And Revisions To The School Building Project Statutes.
description: To authorize state grant commitments for school building projects and make revisions to the school building project statutes.

title: An Act Concerning Proposals Derived From The Waste Characterization Study.
description: To require the submission of proposals derived from the results of the waste characterization study.

title: An Act Concerning Certain Authorities Related To The Prevention Of Wildfires.
description: To augment certain authority of the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection and the Governor concerning measures to prevent wildfires.

title: An Act Concerning Minor Revisions To Department Of Energy And Environmental Protection Related Statutes.
description: To make minor revisions to various statutes under the authority of the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection.

title: An Act Concerning Certain Revisions To The Department Of Energy And Environmental Protection's Permitting Authority.
description: To authorize the issuance of general permits in lieu of individual permits and to provide for the renewal of certain solid waste facility permits.

title: An Act Concerning Pesticide Reporting Modernization.
description: To require the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection to institute the use of modern technology and methodologies for the reporting of pesticide applications in the state and enable ready knowledge of where pesticides are being used, what pesticides are being used and the quantities of pesticides that are being used.

title: An Act Concerning A Climate Change Superfund.
description: To establish a climate change superfund to be used to fund certain adaptive infrastructure projects.

title: An Act Concerning The Tire Stewardship Program.
description: To give retailers until July 1, 2027, to participate in the tire stewardship program.

title: An Act Prohibiting Scholarship Displacement.
description: To prohibit an institution of higher education from reducing the amount of financial aid awarded to a student as result of such student receiving a scholarship.

title: An Act Funding Journalism Fellowships For Graduates Of Public Institutions Of Higher Education.
description: To require the Office of Higher Education to establish a journalism fellowship program to fund not fewer than twelve journalism fellowship positions at local news organizations.

title: An Act Appropriating Funds To Assist Homeless Persons.
description: To provide funding to the Department of Housing to assist homeless persons.

title: An Act Requiring The Collection Of Identifying Information Of Nonresident Owners Of Residential Property.
description: To require the collection of identifying information of nonresident owners of residential property.

title: An Act Amending An Authorization Of Bonds Of The State For A Grant-in-aid To The Connecticut Housing Finance Authority.
description: To amend a bond authorization for the Connecticut Housing Finance Authority's emergency mortgage assistance program to permit the funds to also be used to capitalize down payment assistance under the homeownership loan program.

title: An Act Establishing A Task Force To Study Methods And Programs For Improving Affordability For Children, Families And Young Professionals.
description: To establish a task force to study methods and programs for improving affordability for children, families and young professionals.

title: An Act Concerning The Use Of Funds In The Tobacco Settlement Fund.
description: To require funding of tobacco control programs to prevent and reduce tobacco use at the amount recommended by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

title: An Act Requiring An Evaluation Of The Appointment Of A Receiver To Manage Hospitals In Financial Distress Or Operational Crisis.
description: To require the Commissioner of Public Health to evaluate whether the Attorney General should be authorized to appoint a receiver to manage hospitals in financial distress or operational crisis.

title: An Act Concerning Social Work Licensure.
description: To eliminate the examination requirement for persons seeking licensure as a master social worker.

title: An Act Concerning The Disclosure Of Water Quality Test Results For Certain Private And Semipublic Wells.
description: To permit the disclosure of private well and semipublic well water quality test results to certain individuals without requiring approval of the Commissioner of Public Health.

title: An Act Concerning The Secure Transmission Of Safety Plans Of Minor Patients To Schools By Health Care Providers.
description: To facilitate communication of minor safety plans between health care providers and schools.

title: An Act Requiring The Establishment Of An Alert In The State-wide Health Information Exchange Regarding Patients With A History Of Violence Or Combative Behavior Toward A Health Care Provider.
description: To require the development of a method of alerting health care providers regarding any patient who has been reported in the State-wide Health Information Exchange as being violent with or displaying combative behavior toward a health care provider.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For Survivors Of Homicide, Inc.
description: To provide funding to Survivors of Homicide, Inc. to provide mental health and supportive counseling to more families after the loss of a loved one to homicide and mitigate a potential loss of funding.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The Connecticut-grown For Connecticut Kids Program.
description: To provide funding to support the Connecticut-Grown for Connecticut Kids program and offer incentives to local farms and food growers.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The Installation And Maintenance Of Radar Speed Signs On Forest Road In The City Of New Haven.
description: To reduce speeding and increase safety on Forest Road in the city of New Haven.

title: An Act Increasing Funding For Youth Summer Employment Programs.
description: To increase funding for youth summer employment programs.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The City Of New London For Loss Of Taxes On Private Tax-exempt Property.
description: To require four million dollars be paid to the city of New London to better reflect the lost property tax revenue from the United States Coast Guard Academy.

title: An Act Concerning Funding To Hire Auditors At The Department Of Revenue Services.
description: To increase appropriation to hire auditors to work for the Department of Revenue Services.

title: An Act Increasing Funding For Spanish Community Of Wallingford.
description: To provide funding to Spanish Community of Wallingford for education, public health, social services and job training.

title: An Act Establishing A Tax Credit For Manufacturers That Donate Equipment Or Supplies To Manufacturing Training Programs At Public Schools.
description: To encourage the donation of equipment and supplies to public middle schools and public high schools in the state that have manufacturing training programs by allowing manufacturers to receive a tax credit for such donations.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For A Culinary Arts Center At Robert E. Fitch High School In The Town Of Groton.
description: To provide funding for a culinary arts center at Robert E. Fitch High School in the town of Groton.

title: An Act Concerning An Increase Of The Per Pupil Foundation Amount For Purposes Of The Education Cost Sharing Grant.
description: To increase the per pupil foundation amount of the education cost sharing grant formula and adding a process for annual increases of such amount based on certain economic indicators.

title: An Act Concerning Charter Schools And Educational Opportunities.
description: To improve educational opportunities for students by adjusting funding for charter schools.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Capital Improvements To Various Community Organizations In The City Of Norwich.
description: To provide funding for capital improvements to various community organizations in the city of Norwich.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Capital Improvements To Fire Service Organizations In The City Of Norwich.
description: To provide funding for capital improvements at Laurel Hill Volunteer Fire Company, East Great Plain Volunteer Fire Department and Norwich Fire Department in the city of Norwich.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For An Exhaust System Upgrade At The Yantic Fire Engine Company In The City Of Norwich.
description: To provide funding to the Yantic Fire Engine Company in the city of Norwich for an exhaust system upgrade.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Improvements And Renovations To Castle Church In The City Of Norwich.
description: To provide funding to complete improvements and renovations to Castle Church in the city of Norwich.

title: An Act Establishing A Capital Gains And Dividends Surcharge.
description: To establish a capital gains and dividends surcharge on taxpayers subject to the highest marginal personal income tax rate.

title: An Act Concerning The Affected Business Entity Tax And The Credit Related Thereto And Establishing A Surcharge On The Amount Of Federal Qualified Business Income Deductions Claimed By Certain Filers.
description: To (1) establish a surcharge on the affected business entity tax and adjust, for certain personal income tax marginal rates, the amount of the credit allowed against said tax, and (2) establish a surcharge on the amount of the qualified business income deduction claimed for federal income tax purposes by filers subject to the highest marginal rate under section 12-700 of the general statutes.

title: An Act Adjusting The Fiscal Guardrails.
description: To adjust the methodology used to calculate the threshold amounts for volatility funds transfers and increase the maximum capacity of the Budget Reserve Fund.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Construction Of The Uss Groton Sail Monument.
description: To provide funding for the construction of the USS Groton Sail Monument.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Holy Trinity Greek Orthodox Church In The City Of Norwich.
description: To provide funding for capital improvements to the Holy Trinity Greek Orthodox Church in the city of Norwich.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Veterans Rally Point In The City Of Norwich.
description: To provide funding for capital improvements to the Veterans Rally Point in the city of Norwich.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For A Fire Service Dispatch System For The City Of Norwich.
description: To provide funding for a fire dispatch system for the city of Norwich.

title: An Act Establishing A Personal Income Tax Deduction For Tips Or Gratuities.
description: To establish a personal income tax deduction for the amount of tips or gratuities declared by a taxpayer for a taxable year.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Capital Improvements To Camp Oakdale In The Town Of Montville.
description: To provide funding for capital improvements to Camp Oakdale in the town of Montville.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The New England Science And Sailing Foundation.
description: To provide funding to the New England Science and Sailing Foundation to ensure its facilities are compliant with physical accessibility guidelines under the federal Americans with Disabilities Act.

title: An Act Establishing A Tax Credit For Businesses That Install A Meadow In Lieu Of A Lawn.
description: To establish a tax credit for businesses that install a meadow in lieu of a lawn on their business properties.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Groton Community Center.
description: To provide funding for planning and engineering the Groton Community Center.

title: An Act Equalizing Adult Access To Medicaid.
description: To provide equal access to Medicaid-funded health care for older adults and adults with disabilities.

title: An Act Disregarding The Value Of Life Insurance Benefits In Eligibility Determinations For Public Assistance Programs.
description: To disregard the value of life insurance policies in eligibility determinations for state-administered public assistance programs.

title: An Act Concerning Reduced Medicaid Reimbursements For Multiple Home Health Visits To The Same Housing Facility.
description: To provide the same Medicaid reimbursement rate for each behavioral health home visit to a building housing more than one resident rather than reduced rates for subsequent visits to the same building by the same behavioral health practitioner.

title: An Act Concerning Medicaid Reimbursement For Safety Escorts.
description: To ensure the safety of behavioral health nurses who provide community-based care to Medicaid beneficiaries.

title: An Act Increasing Funding For Certain Transition Services Offered To Students.
description: To expand the availability of transition services for students under Project SEARCH.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For Emergency Housing.
description: To fund Continuum of Care, Inc.'s emergency housing program.

title: An Act Establishing A Qualified Production Property Deduction.
description: To establish a state tax deduction for the amount of the federal qualified production property deduction claim.

title: An Act Dedicating A Portion Of The Room Occupancy Tax On Short-term Rental Properties To Municipalities.
description: To dedicate a portion of the room occupancy tax received by the state from short-term rentals to the municipalities in which such rentals are situated.

title: An Act Dedicating A Portion Of The Room Occupancy Tax On Short-term Rental Properties To Municipalities.
description: To dedicate a portion of the room occupancy tax received by the state from short-term rentals to the municipalities in which such rentals are situated.

title: An Act Establishing A Tax Credit Against The Personal Income Tax For Volunteer Firefighters Who Meet Certain Service Requirements.
description: To establish a tax credit for volunteer firefighters who meet certain service requirements.

title: An Act Concerning The Full Funding Of The Special Education And Expansion Development Grant.
description: To fully fund the special education and expansion development grant.

title: An Act Requiring A Study Concerning Financial Transactions In The State.
description: To require the Department of Banking to study and submit a report concerning financial transactions in the state.

title: An Act Establishing Various Requirements Regarding Shared Appreciation Agreements.
description: To establish various requirements regarding shared appreciation agreements.

title: An Act Establishing Various Data Security Requirements Applicable To Certain Financial Institutions.
description: To establish various data security requirements applicable to certain financial institutions.

title: An Act Concerning Commercial Financing.
description: To redefine "commercial financing", require commercial financing providers to disclose estimated annual percentage rates and revise and establish certain requirements applicable to commercial financing contracts.

title: An Act Requiring Acceptance Of Periodic And Partial Payments On Certain Mortgage Loans Issued By Connecticut Banks And Connecticut Credit Unions.
description: To require certain payments on mortgage loans issued by Connecticut banks and Connecticut credit unions on and after October 1, 2026, to be accepted and credited or treated as credited.

title: An Act Establishing A Working Group To Evaluate Payroll Processing Methods Employed By Financial Institutions.
description: To establish a working group to evaluate payroll processing methods employed by financial institutions and the time required for payroll checks to clear.

title: An Act Concerning School Meals.
description: To provide free school breakfasts to all students in the state and to provide free school lunches for all students who are eligible for free or reduced priced lunches in the state.

title: An Act Concerning The Legislative Commissioners' Recommendations For Technical Revisions To The Education And Early Childhood Statutes.
description: To make technical revisions to the education and early childhood statutes.

title: An Act Concerning Stipends For Student Teachers.
description: To require payment of stipends to student teachers for each week of student teaching experience at a public school in the state.

title: An Act Establishing The Commissioner Of Education As The Department Head Of The Department Of Education.
description: To make the Commissioner of Education the department head of the Department of Education.

title: An Act Concerning Teachers.
description: To (1) establish a just cause standard for teacher termination decisions, (2) make the decision of a neutral arbitrator in a termination hearing binding, and (3) provide full workers' compensation coverage for teachers injured by students in the course of their employment.

title: An Act Concerning The Order Of Gubernatorial Succession Under Certain Permanent And Temporary Circumstances.
description: To expand upon the order of gubernatorial succession set forth in the state Constitution under certain permanent and temporary circumstances.

title: An Act Increasing The Membership And Compensation Of The State Properties Review Board.
description: To increase the membership of the State Properties Review Board from six members to eight members and increase the compensation of members of the board.

title: An Act Reestablishing The Legislative Program Review And Investigations Committee.
description: To reestablish the Legislative Program Review and Investigations Committee.

title: An Act Concerning The Department Of Consumer Protection's Recommendations Regarding Various Statutes Concerning Consumer Protection.
description: To implement the Department of Consumer Protection's recommendations regarding (1) the Board of Accountancy, (2) professional engineers and land surveyors, (3) real estate brokers and real estate salespersons, (4) plumbing and piping work, (5) businesses engaged in providing certain skilled trade work or services, (6) interior designers, (7) adulterated or misbranded foods, beverages and ingredients, (8) donation bins, (9) funeral service contracts, (10) apartment listing services, and (11) various minor, technical and conforming changes to statutes concerning consumer protection.

title: An Act Establishing A Task Force To Study Issues Concerning Grocery Store Beer Permits.
description: To establish a task force to study issues concerning grocery store beer permits.

title: An Act Concerning The Department Of Consumer Protection's Recommendations Regarding Various Guaranty Funds.
description: To (1) transfer to the Department of Consumer Protection various duties concerning the Real Estate and Connecticut Health Club Guaranty Funds, (2) with respect to the Real Estate Guaranty Fund, (A) provide that no application to recover compensation from said fund shall be brought later than two years from final determination of, or expiration of time for appeal in connection with, a binding arbitration decision or a court order or decree, and (B) subrogate the department to the rights of the creditor under a decision, order or decree, (3) require an applicant for payment from the Home Improvement Guaranty Fund to attest that the applicant made a good faith effort to satisfy a decision, judgment order or decree against a contractor or proprietor, (4) provide that interest shall not accrue on a debt owed to the Real Estate, Home Improvement, Connecticut Health Club or New Home Construction Guaranty Fund after such debt has been referred to the Department of Administrative Services for collection, and (5) repeal a provision concerning the Connecticut Real Estate Commission's procedure following receipt of a notice concerning the Real Estate Guaranty Fund.

title: An Act Prohibiting Certain Licensees And Registrants From Selling, Dispensing, Transferring Or Delivering Any Drug Or Device To Execute A Sentence Of Death.
description: To provide that no manufacturer, wholesaler, pharmacist, prescribing practitioner or pharmacy shall sell, dispense, transfer or deliver, as applicable, any drug or device with actual knowledge that the person purchasing or receiving such drug or device directly from such manufacturer, wholesaler, pharmacist, prescribing practitioner or pharmacy intends to use such drug or device to execute a sentence of death.

title: An Act Concerning Mobile Manufactured Homes And Mobile Manufactured Home Parks.
description: To (1) require a regional council of governments to establish a fair rent commission if a mobile manufactured home park is located in any municipality that is a member of such council, (2) require a mobile manufactured home park owner to make available, on a disclosure statement, an enumeration of all considerations payable by a resident to the owner, including, but not limited to, all periodic fees, usage fees and penalty fees payable by the resident to the owner, (3) modify the amount of relocation expenses paid to mobile manufactured home park residents, (4) modify the process by which, and terms upon which, an association of resident owners may exercise its right to purchase a mobile manufactured home park, (5) require the Department of Consumer Protection to promptly acknowledge receipt of a complaint submitted by a mobile manufactured home park resident, and (6) require a mobile manufactured home park owner to deliver a written notice of a proposed rent increase to a resident at least ninety days before the start of a new rental agreement.

title: An Act Concerning Mold Remediation.
description: To (1) require persons performing mold remediation for compensation in the state to register with the Department of Consumer Protection, (2) establish standards for the performance of mold remediation, and (3) provide that no certificate shall be given under the Home Improvement Act to any person who holds such person out to be a contractor that performs mold remediation unless such person provides evidence, satisfactory to the Commissioner of Consumer Protection, that the contractor is certified as a mold remediator.

title: An Act Concerning Cigarette Dealers And Electronic Nicotine Delivery System And Vapor Product Dealers.
description: To provide that (1) the Department of Revenue Services shall not issue a cigarette dealer's license, or renew any such license, for certain applicants who exceed certain limitations concerning annual gross sales and the use of retail sales area, and (2) the Department of Consumer Protection shall not issue an electronic nicotine delivery system certificate of dealer registration, or renew any such registration, for certain applicants who (A) exceed certain limitations concerning annual gross revenue and the use of retail sales area, or (B) are located in a town that already includes one dealer for every two thousand five hundred residents.

title: An Act Concerning Gaming.
description: To restrict gaming advertising at college and university campuses, establish requirements regarding withdrawal of funds from gaming accounts, require gaming licensees to maintain customer service telephone numbers and bar the use of artificial intelligence for targeting certain bets to customers making online sports wagers.

title: An Act Exempting Income Of Up To One Hundred Thousand Dollars Earned By A Child Under The Age Of Twenty-four From Inclusion In The Parent's Gross Income For Determination Of The Parent's Eligibility To Participate In The Rental Assistance Program.
description: To exempt income of up to one hundred thousand dollars earned by a child living with a parent from such parent's gross income for the purpose of determining the parent's eligibility to participate in the rental assistance program.

title: An Act Expanding A Personal Income Tax Deduction To Include Certain Members Of The Uniformed Services.
description: To expand a personal income tax deduction for certain retirement pay to include retirees of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration and the Public Health Service.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For A Youth Baseball And Softball Indoor Training Facility In The Town Of Manchester.
description: To provide funding for an indoor training facility and increase the after-school opportunities for youth in the town of Manchester.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Improvements To Water And Sewer Infrastructure In The Town Of Manchester.
description: To provided funding for improvements to the water and sewer infrastructure in the north end of the town of Manchester.

title: An Act Establishing A Fee On Short-term Rental Properties.
description: To establish a fee on short-term rental properties and distribute the revenue generated from the fee proportionally to municipalities.

title: An Act Concerning A Plan And Coordinated Response To Persons Experiencing Homelessness On Property Under The Control Of The Department Of Transportation.
description: To require the Commissioner of Transportation to develop a plan to respond to temporary encampments by persons experiencing homelessness on any state highway right-of-way or real property in the custody of the Department of Transportation.

title: An Act Concerning Workplace Health, Safety And Violence Prevention For Public Transit Workers.
description: To (1) establish a Public Transit Workplace Health, Safety and Violence Prevention Committee, and (2) require each public transit bus operated by the Department of Transportation or a transit district to be equipped with a security barrier for the protection and safety of public transit bus operators.

title: An Act Implementing Recommendations By The Department Of Motor Vehicles.
description: To implement recommendations by the Department of Motor Vehicles regarding (1) records relating to vessels, (2) the definition of "commissioner", (3) the replacement of a certificate of title, and (4) the proclamation of an Accessible Parking Awareness Day.

title: An Act Studying Access To Parking For Home Health Care Service Providers.
description: To require the Commissioner of Emergency Services and Public Protection to establish a working group to study access to parking for home health care service providers.

title: An Act Concerning The Department Of Developmental Services' Recommendations Regarding The Independent Mortality Review Board And Fatality Review Board.
description: To codify the duties and responsibilities of the Independent Mortality Review Board and avoid duplication of such duties and responsibilities in the Fatality Review Board.

title: An Act Concerning The Department Of Developmental Services' Recommendations Regarding Various Revisions To Developmental Services Statutes.
description: To make various revisions to developmental services statutes.

title: An Act Establishing A Triple Bottom Line Justice Demonstration Pilot Program.
description: To establish a Triple Bottom Line Justice demonstration pilot program.

title: An Act Requiring Certain Health Care Facilities To Allow Terminally Ill Qualifying Patients To Use Cannabis.
description: To require certain health care facilities to allow terminally ill qualifying patients to use medical marijuana.

title: An Act Concerning Economic Development Of The Greater Mystic Area.
description: To facilitate economic development in the greater Mystic area.

title: An Act Concerning The Department Of Economic And Community Development's Recommendations Regarding The Agency Financial Assistance Cap And Employment Promissory Notes.
description: To (1) increase the financial assistance cap provided in section 32-462, and (2) create an exception to the employment promissory note prohibition in section 31-51r.

title: An Act Concerning Municipal Electric Aggregation Programs.
description: To allow a municipality, or two or more municipalities acting jointly, to establish municipal aggregation programs.

title: An Act Concerning The Legislative Commissioners' Recommendations For Technical Revisions To Statutes Concerning Energy And Technology.
description: To make minor and technical revisions to statutes concerning energy and technology.

title: An Act Concerning A Test Bed Technologies Program And The Jobsct Tax Rebate Program.
description: To (1) facilitate the consideration of cost-saving technology by evaluating testing such technology by state agencies, and (2) amend eligibility criteria for the JobsCT tax rebate program.

title: An Act Concerning Energy Efficiency And Transmission Planning.
description: To (1) allow the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to adopt efficiency standards for certain new products if determined necessary by the commissioner, and (2) require the Connecticut Siting Council to consider future electric grid reliability needs when determining whether to approve certain facilities.

title: An Act Amending The Charter Of The South Central Connecticut Regional Water Authority Concerning The Potential Acquisition Of A Water Company.
description: To amend the charter of the South Central Connection Regional Water Authority concerning the potential acquisition of a water company.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Freedom Of Information Commission For Revisions To The Freedom Of Information Act.
description: To make revisions to the Freedom of Information Act recommended by the Freedom of Information Commission, including concerning the application of the definition of "governmental function", which statutory provisions require training by the commission, redefining "hand-held scanner", electronic notice of special meetings and appeals for denial of access to certain public records.

title: An Act Concerning Reporting On Implementation Of Certain Consultant Report Recommendations.
description: To require the reporting of state agency implementation of certain consultant reports.

title: An Act Requiring The Auditors Of Public Accounts And Office Of Policy And Management To Review The Costs Of Providing Certain Public And Private Services To Individuals With Intellectual Disabilities.
description: To require the Auditors of Public Accounts and the Secretary of the Office of Policy and Management to review the costs of providing public versus private services to individuals with intellectual disabilities.

title: An Act Concerning Voting Procedures For And State Elections Enforcement Commission Oversight Of Fire Districts.
description: To (1) require certain voting procedures for the transaction of business at meetings of fire districts, and (2) authorize State Elections Enforcement Commission jurisdiction over fire districts in matters relating to the conduct of such meetings, including such voting procedures.

title: An Act Concerning The Process And Timetable For The Review Of Existing Regulations Of Connecticut State Agencies.
description: To make modifications to the process for reviewing agency regulations to determine whether they are obsolete, inconsistent or ineffective and change the deadlines for such review.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Auditors Of Public Accounts Concerning Oversight Of State Agency Grants.
description: To implement the recommendations of the Auditors of Public Accounts requiring the developing of standard requirements for the award and subaward of state grant funds and subsequent monitoring of the use of such grant funds, training of state agency employees in such standards and annual reporting concerning such awards and subawards.

title: An Act Concerning The Process For Initiating Local Legislation In The General Assembly.
description: To remove the requirement that a copy of the resolution or petition of a town, city, borough or other local government to initiate local legislation in the General Assembly be filed with the Secretary of the State.

title: An Act Prohibiting A Landlord From Requiring A Security Deposit In Excess Of One Month's Rent From Any Tenant.
description: To prohibit landlords from requiring a security deposit in excess of one month's rent from any tenant.

title: An Act Concerning Tenant Organizational Activities.
description: To require landlords to permit certain tenant organizational activities in residential property.

title: An Act Concerning The Education Of Homeless Children And Youth.
description: To codify rights pertaining to school district choice, transportation, notice and appeal for students experiencing homelessness and their guardians.

title: An Act Prohibiting A Municipality From Imposing A Penalty For The Performance Of Certain Activities Of Daily Living.
description: To prohibit municipalities from enacting or enforcing a prohibition on the performance of certain activities of daily living.

title: An Act Permitting Municipalities To Prohibit Rent Increases In The Event Of Multiple State Building Code Violations.
description: To allow municipalities to prohibit rent increases on residential properties with multiple outstanding State Building Code violations.

title: An Act Concerning Certain Electronic Notice Requirements For Property And Casualty Insurers, The State Insurance And Risk Management Board's Reserve Funding, Review Of The Motor Vehicle Glass Repair National Model, And The Office Of Health Strategy's Reporting Requirements Related To Prescription Drug Formularies.
description: To: (1) Revise certain electronic notice requirements for property and casualty insurers; (2) allow the State Insurance and Risk Management Board to fund reserves using certain funds; (3) require the Insurance Commissioner to conduct a review of the motor vehicle glass repair national model; and (4) remove the Office of Health Strategy's study and reporting requirement related to prescription drug formularies.

title: An Act Concerning The Assignment Of Post-loss Homeowners And Commercial Property Insurance Benefits, Consumer Bill Of Rights And Revising Disclosure Requirements For Home Improvement Contractors And Salespersons.
description: To: (1) Establish a process for the assignment of post-loss benefits under homeowners and commercial property insurance policies; (2) modify the required terms of home improvement contracts; (3) preclude home improvement contractors from engaging in certain conduct to induce owners to enter into home improvement contracts; (4) require home improvement contractors to notify the commissioner regarding changes in their business names, trade names and addresses; (5) require home improvement contractors to maintain additional types of insurance coverage; (6) expand the required content of the application for a certificate of registration as a home improvement contractor; (7) modify the grounds on which the Commissioner of Consumer Protection may (A) reprimand or place a home improvement contractor or salesperson on probation, or (B) revoke, suspend, or refuse to issue or renew a certificate of registration as a home improvement contractor or salesperson; and (8) require the Insurance Commissioner to create a consumer bill of rights.

title: An Act Concerning Service Animals In Insurance Underwriting, The Appointment Of An Advocate In Proceedings Concerning The Welfare Or Custody Of Companion Animals, Assault Of A Domestic Animal And Establishing An Animal Abuse Task Force.
description: To: (1) Prohibit any homeowners insurance or tenants insurance policy from discriminating based on owning any dog that is a dog trained or being trained as a service animal to assist blind, deaf or mobility impaired persons or is a therapy animal, (2) allow the court to appoint an advocate in proceedings concerning the welfare or custody of companion animals, (3) expand assault in the third degree to include domestic animals, and (4) establish an animal abuse task force.

title: An Act Concerning Court-ordered Accountings Of Common Interest Community Financial Records, Lender Questionnaires And Revising The Disclosure Requirements Relating To Common Interest Communities.
description: To (1) allow unit owners of common interest communities to petition the Superior Court for an accounting of such association's financial records, (2) revise the disclosure requirements relating to common interest communities, and (3) impose a cap on the fee imposed for the preparation and recordation of a lender questionnaire.

title: An Act Adopting The Uniform Real Property Transfer On Death Act.
description: To adopt the Uniform Real Property Transfer on Death Act.

title: An Act Concerning Eligibility For Incapacity Benefits Under The Workers' Compensation Act.
description: To preclude an employee from seeking incapacity benefits when the employee elects to retire from the workforce and experiences the incapacity after such retirement.

title: An Act Authorizing The Department Of Public Health To Release Information Relating To An Acknowledgment Of Parentage To The Department Of Children And Families.
description: To authorize the Department of Public Health to release information relating to an acknowledgment of parentage to the Department of Children and Families.

title: An Act Establishing A Working Group To Study Energy Drink Consumption By Children And Requiring Certain Signage At The Point Of Sale Of Such Drinks.
description: To establish a working group to study the consumption of energy drinks by children and require signage concerning risks associated with such consumption at the point of sale of such drinks.

title: An Act Extending Financial Assistance For The Postsecondary Education Expenses Of Foster Youth.
description: To require the Department of Children and Families to continue to provide financial aid for the postsecondary education expenses for foster youth until such youth reaches twenty-eight years of age.

title: An Act Requiring The Office Of The Child Advocate To Hire Certain Additional Employees.
description: To require the Office of the Child Advocate to hire one or more full-time employees to assist in the oversight of children in the care of the Department of Children and Families.

title: An Act Concerning Children's Health.
description: To require the Commissioner of Children and Families to conduct a study to determine whether policy and procedural changes within the Department of Children and Families may improve the health of children.

title: An Act Requiring Children Under The Age Of Twelve To Wear Personal Flotation Devices On Docks, Wharfs And Piers.
description: To require children under the age of twelve to wear personal flotation devices while on any dock, wharf or pier.

title: An Act Concerning The Workers' Compensation System.
description: To require the Workers' Compensation Commission to study the workers' compensation system in the state.

title: An Act Concerning A Contractor's Responsibility For Unpaid Wages On A Construction Contract.
description: To make a contractor liable for unpaid wages owed to an employee of a subcontractor at any tier who performs work on any portion of a construction contract.

title: An Act Concerning Volunteer Fire Departments And The Definition Of Employer Under The State Occupational Health And Safety Act.
description: To ensure volunteer fire departments and ambulance companies are considered under CONN-OSHA jurisdiction.

title: An Act Concerning The Posting Of Veterans' Information And Services For Display In The Workplace.
description: To require the Labor Commissioner and the Chief Manufacturing Officer, in consultation with the Commissioner of Veterans Affairs, to post information on the Internet web sites of the Labor Department and the Office of Manufacturing available for download by employers to display in the workplace.

title: An Act Requiring Uninsured And Underinsured Motorist Coverage For Department Of Transportation Employees.
description: To require the state to provide uninsured and underinsured motorist coverage to employees of the Department of Transportation.

title: An Act Adding Witnessing A Serious Physical Injury As A Qualifying Event For Purposes Of Post-traumatic Stress Injury Workers' Compensation Coverage.
description: To add witnessing a serious physical injury that does not result in the death or permanent disfigurement of such person as a qualifying event for an employee to be eligible for workers' compensation coverage for a post-traumatic stress injury.

title: An Act Concerning A Noncharge For Employees Paid Benefits Through The Shared Work Program During Periods Of High Unemployment.
description: To allow for a noncharge to an employer's experience account for employees who were paid benefits through the shared work program for claims filed in a week in which the state is in an extended benefit period or a high unemployment period.

title: An Act Concerning Planning And Development.
description: To clarify certain publication requirements of actions or decisions of a planning commission.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Continuing Legislative Committee On Planning And Development Concerning The State Plan Of Conservation And Development.
description: To increase cost thresholds relating to certain actions required to be undertaken consistent with the state plan of conservation and development, eliminate a requirement that certain acquisitions by state agencies be consistent with such plan and eliminate priority funding areas.

title: An Act Authorizing Municipalities To Prohibit The Sale Of Dogs, Cats And Rabbits In Pet Shops.
description: To authorize municipalities to prohibit the sale of certain animals in pet shops.

title: An Act Concerning Property Tax Abatement For Certain First-time Homebuyers.
description: To authorize municipalities to abate up to five hundred dollars per assessment year of property taxes for certain first-time homebuyers who obtain a loan from the Connecticut Housing Finance Authority.

title: An Act Concerning The Assessment Of Certain Motor Vehicles.
description: To specify that older motor vehicles shall be assessed at a rate of ten per cent of the manufacturer's suggested retail price or five hundred dollars, whichever is less, except that in a municipality that has elected to adopt a modified depreciation schedule, such motor vehicles shall be assessed at a rate of fifteen per cent of the manufacturer's suggested retail price or five hundred dollars, whichever is less.

title: An Act Concerning A Municipal Tax Abatement For Surviving Domestic Partners Of Police Officers, Firefighters And Emergency Medical Technicians.
description: To extend a property tax abatement for surviving spouses of certain first responders who die in the performance of duty to the domestic partners of such first responders.

title: An Act Concerning The Legislative Commissioners' Recommendations For Technical Revisions To Statutes Relating To Planning And Development.
description: To make technical revisions to statutes relating to planning and development.

title: An Act Concerning Utility Connections For Accessory Dwelling Units.
description: To (1) change statutory references to "accessory apartments" to "accessory dwelling units", and (2) specify that towns, districts or utilities may not require separate utility connections for accessory apartments pursuant to special act zoning regulations.

title: An Act Concerning The Publication Of Municipal Legal Notices.
description: To require municipalities to publish legal notices on their Internet web sites.

title: An Act Concerning Coastal Site Plan Reviews For Certain Single-family Residential Structures.
description: To allow zoning commissions to exempt certain single-family residential structures from requirements concerning coastal site plan reviews and instead submit quarterly reports to the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection concerning the approval of such structures.

title: An Act Concerning The Department Of Emergency Services And Public Protection's Recommendations Regarding Various Statutes Relating To Public Safety.
description: To implement various recommendations of the Department of Emergency Services and Public Protection concerning (1) the appointment of new or interim fire chiefs, (2) chemical tests of criminal defendants' breath, (3) blood or other biological samples for DNA analysis required from certain arrested or convicted persons, (4) a study of lawfully owed DNA, (5) the membership of the Police Officer Standards and Training Council, (6) standards for determining the proposed level of staffing for the Division of State Police, (7) the school security infrastructure competitive grant program, (8) certificates of competency regarding fireworks and special effects, (9) the holding of firearms or other deadly weapons and ammunition seized pursuant to certain warrants, (10) security officers, and (11) professional bondsmen, surety bail bond agents and bail enforcement agents.

title: An Act Exempting Certain Sales To Military And Veterans-related Organizations From The Sales And Use Taxes.
description: To exempt from the sales and use taxes the sale of and the storage, use or other consumption in this state of tangible personal property or services to certain military and veterans-related organizations described in Section 501(c)(19) of the Internal Revenue Code.

title: An Act Concerning The Department Of Veterans Affairs And A Connecticut Veterans Cemetery.
description: To require the Department of Veterans Affairs to, not later than July 1, 2027, designate or acquire land as an appropriate final resting place for deceased Connecticut veterans.

title: An Act Concerning The Adjutant General's Recommendations Regarding Service In The Militia.
description: To (1) specify that all citizens and state residents intending to become United States citizens, between the ages of eighteen and forty-five, are subject to state military duty, (2) provide for greater discretion in the appointment of the Governor's military staff, and (3) rename the state military training facility in Niantic as Camp Nett.

title: An Act Naming The Connecticut National Guard Readiness Center In The Town Of Putnam.
description: To name the Connecticut National Guard Readiness Center in Putnam in honor of former Governor John Dempsey.

title: An Act Establishing A Personal Income Tax Deduction For National Guard State Active Duty Pay.
description: To establish a personal income tax deduction for pay received by National Guard members as a result of orders to active duty.

title: An Act Concerning Qualified Veterans' Charitable Organizations And The Department Of Veterans Affairs Internet Web Site.
description: To require the Commissioner of Veterans Affairs to annually solicit organizations for inclusion on the list of qualified veterans' charitable organizations published on the Internet web site of the Department of Veterans Affairs.

title: An Act Establishing A Grant Program For Capital Expenditure Projects To Place Or Maintain War Or Veterans' Memorials Or Monuments.
description: To establish a grant program to be administered by the Department of Veterans Affairs for the purpose of assisting municipalities and nonprofit veterans' organizations with certain veterans-related capital expenditure projects.

title: An Act Allowing Trained Assisted Living Aides To Administer Medication To Assisted Living Residents.
description: To allow trained assisted living aides to administer medication to assisted living residents.

title: An Act Concerning Cost Of Living Adjustments To Long-term Care Facility Residents' Personal Needs Allowance.
description: To provide cost-of-living adjustments to long-term care facility residents' personal needs allowance.

title: An Act Excluding Spousal Income From Certain Rent, Fee And Cost-sharing Calculations Relating To Home And Community-based Services.
description: To exclude spousal income from income eligibility determinations relating to home and community-based services waiver programs.

title: An Act Concerning Asset Limits For Husky C Beneficiaries.
description: To increase the HUSKY C asset limit for (1) an unmarried person from one thousand six hundred dollars to five thousand dollars, and (2) married persons from two thousand four hundred dollars to seven thousand five hundred dollars.

title: An Act Allowing Dental Hygienists To Provide Dental Hygiene Services In Private Residences.
description: To allow dental hygienists to provide dental hygiene services in private residences.

title: An Act Concerning Long-term Care Insurance Premium Rates.
description: To (1) allow an income tax deduction for long-term care insurance premiums, (2) require the Insurance Department to hold a public hearing for long-term care premium rate increase requests that exceed ten per cent, and (3) require that policyholders are provided advance notice of such hearing.

title: An Act Concerning Adult Day Center Transportation.
description: To (1) increase the fee schedule effective July 1, 2026, for adult day care services by ten per cent over the fee schedule for adult day care services for the previous fiscal year for the purpose of providing increased funding for adult day care transportation, and (2) provide for annual cost of living increases to such fee schedule.

title: An Act Concerning Sentence Reduction Or Relief For Survivors Of Domestic Violence, Sexual Assault, Stalking Or Human Trafficking.
description: To permit survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, stalking or trafficking in persons for whom violence or abuse suffered by such survivors was a contributing factor influencing such survivor to commit an offense to be eligible for a sentence reduction or relief.

title: An Act Concerning The Provision Of Notice To A Parent Or Guardian Of A Minor Child Who Has Received Pregnancy-related Health Care Services.
description: To ensure that the parent or guardian of a minor is provided notice of the minor child having received pregnancy-related health care services.

title: An Act Concerning Post-conviction Dna Testing.
description: To (1) expand the time period permissible for the filing of a petition for post-conviction DNA testing, and (2) set forth that the denial of such petition is a final judgment for purposes of an appeal.

title: An Act Concerning The Provision Of Notice To A Parent Or Guardian Of A Minor Child Who Seeks To Receive Pregnancy-related Health Care Services.
description: To (1) require the provision of notice to a parent or guardian of a minor child who seeks to receive pregnancy-related health care services, and (2) establish a court process to determine if such notice must be provided in a situation involving a minor child who does not want such notice to be provided.

title: An Act Concerning An Affirmative Defense For A Criminal Violation Of A Protective Order Or A Standing Restraining Order.
description: To establish an affirmative defense for a criminal violation of a protective order or a standing restraining order in the case of contact being initiated by a protected person.

title: An Act Concerning The Nonissuance Of A Standing Criminal Protective Order In The Case Of A Family Violence Crime.
description: To require that in the case of a court declining to issue a standing criminal protective order in the case of a family violence crime, the court shall enter into the record the reasons for not issuing such order.

title: An Act Establishing A Civil Action For The Office Of The Attorney General And A Private Right Of Action For Victims Of Unlawful Dissemination Of A Synthetically Created Intimate Image.
description: To establish a private right of action and a civil action for the office of the Attorney General to pursue damages from an operator of an electronic digital platform who fails to take down a synthetically created intimate image when the operator knew or should have known that dissemination of such image was unlawful.

title: An Act Concerning The Development And Implementation Of A Plan For The Use Of Uniform State-wide Case Identification Codes In Domestic Violence Cases.
description: To require the Chief Court Administrator, or the administrator's designee to develop and implement a plan to facilitate the use of uniform state-wide case identification codes in domestic violence cases.

title: An Act Concerning The "homes For Ct" Loan Program.
description: To (1) establish that loans made by eligible financial institutions participating in the "Homes for CT" loan program shall bear interest at a rate that does not exceed the prime rate published by The Wall Street Journal, and (2) revise provisions relating to loans and grants-in-aid that are made or issued by the Connecticut Housing Finance Authority under said loan program.

title: An Act Establishing A Working Group To Study Consumer Fraud And Protections Against Such Fraud.
description: To (1) establish a working group to study consumer fraud and protections against such fraud, and (2) require such working group to submit a report on its findings and recommendations to the joint standing committee of the General Assembly having cognizance of matters relating to banking.

title: An Act Prohibiting Real Estate Investment Trusts From Acquiring Or Increasing Operational Control Over Hospitals Or Health Systems And Prohibiting Hospitals And Health Systems From Entering Into Sale-leaseback Financing Transactions.
description: To prohibit (1) a real estate investment trust from acquiring or increasing operational control over a hospital or health system, and (2) a hospital or health system from entering into a sale-leaseback transaction involving hospital or health system-owned real property that constitutes the main campus of a hospital.

title: An Act Defining "mortgage Loan" For Purposes Of Certain Notice Provisions Relating To Flood Damage And Insurance.
description: To define "mortgage loan" for purposes of certain notice provisions relating to flood damage and insurance.

title: An Act Concerning Committee Banking Accounts.
description: To require banking institutions to make candidate committee banking accounts available to candidate committees.

title: An Act Concerning A Research And Development Tax Credit For Small Businesses.
description: To require the Department of Economic and Community Development to administer a system of tax credit vouchers to allow qualified small businesses to earn and utilize credits for research and development expenses.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of The Establishment Of A Connecticut Bridge Authority.
description: To allow the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to study the feasibility of establishing a Connecticut Bridge Authority tasked with overseeing the funding and construction of a bridge connecting Connecticut to Long Island.

title: An Act Concerning Workforce Shortages, Workforce Development And Workforce Training.
description: To require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to study workforce shortages, workforce development and workforce training availability.

title: An Act Concerning A Working Group Regarding Endometriosis.
description: To establish a working group regarding endometriosis.

title: An Act Concerning Various Revisions To The Education Statutes.
description: To make various revisions to the education statutes.

title: An Act Concerning Education Mandate Relief.
description: To repeal and reduce education mandates.

title: An Act Concerning Special Education.
description: To require cameras in seclusion rooms and make minor revisions to the special education statutes.

title: An Act Increasing The Rates For The Birth-to-three Program.
description: To increase the rates paid to providers for birth-to-three services.

title: An Act Authorizing The Disclosure Of An Open Investigation Of Abuse Or Neglect Or Sexual Misconduct In The Hiring Process Of School Employees.
description: To authorize a former employer to disclose to a hiring school district any open or pending investigation of abuse or neglect or sexual misconduct of an applicant for a position with such hiring school district.

title: An Act Establishing A Working Group To Address Islamophobia In Schools.
description: To establish a working group to address Islamophobia in schools.

title: An Act Establishing The Connecticut Education Innovation Grant Program.
description: To require the establishment of the Connecticut Education Innovation Grant Program to fund educational innovations in schools in the state.

title: An Act Concerning Certain Wildlife Action Plans.
description: To establish a working group to develop a plan for funding the state's conservation program for wildlife not usually harvested.

title: An Act Concerning The Air Permits Of Certain Crematories.
description: To authorize the continued operations of certain crematories in the state while air permits for such crematories are being processed and renewed.

title: An Act Concerning Certain Boating Regulations.
description: To prohibit the act of extending one's limbs over the gunwale of a vessel while it is in operation, increase the abandoned vessel fine and authorize the recovery of costs associated with abandoned vessels for state and local law enforcement agencies.

title: An Act Concerning The Regulation Of Fisheries In The State.
description: To clarify penalties for violating regulations concerning the taking of striped bass, prohibit the use of horseshoe crabs as bait, authorize the sale of certain lobsters from out-of-state by food service establishments and prohibit certain bait fishing in the Housatonic River and harvesting of striped bass.

title: An Act Concerning Riparian Areas.
description: To create greater protection and preservation of areas immediately adjacent to watercourses in the state in order to preserve and improve the quality of such watercourses.

title: An Act Concerning The Safety Capacity Of Burr Pond State Park In Torrington.
description: To establish a safety capacity for Burr Pond for the protection of park attendees and the vehicular traffic in the area of said park.

title: An Act Concerning Advanced Nuclear Energy.
description: To require the Connecticut Council for Advancing Nuclear Energy Development to conduct a study and make recommendations concerning skilled labor needs in the advanced nuclear energy industry.

title: An Act Concerning District Heating System Incentives.
description: To require the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to establish an incentive program for end use customers who connect to a district heating system.

title: An Act Concerning The Designation Of Certain Service Providers For Purposes Of The Federal Lifeline Service Benefits.
description: To authorize the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to determine which telecommunications service providers are eligible to provide benefits pursuant to the federal lifeline program.

title: An Act Concerning The Permitting Of Solar Photovoltaic Systems.
description: To require the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to conduct a study of municipal permitting and inspection processes concerning the installation of residential solar photovoltaic systems.

title: An Act Concerning Renewable Power Generation.
description: To (1) require the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to develop successor programs for the RRES, NRES and SCEF programs, (2) require a study of consumer protections for solar photovoltaic system leasing and sales, (3) allow the use of portable solar photovoltaic systems, (4) require the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to implement an agrivoltaics program, and (5) require the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to establish a pilot program concerning the installation of solar photovoltaic systems in environmental justice communities.

title: An Act Establishing An Electronic Portal For Applications For State Grant Programs.
description: To require the Secretary of the Office of Policy and Management to establish an electronic portal containing information regarding state grant programs, including applications for such programs.

title: An Act Concerning The Use Of Artificial Intelligence And Other Means To Generate Deceptive Synthetic Media And Affect Elections.
description: To prohibit distribution of certain deceptive synthetic media within the ninety-day period preceding an election or primary.

title: An Act Concerning The Reporting Of Advertising Purchased By The State.
description: To require annual reporting of state agency purchase of advertising.

title: An Act Concerning Superior Court Venue For Election Cases.
description: To require that certain election-related filings be made in the superior court for the judicial district of Hartford or the superior court for the judicial district of Bridgeport.

title: An Act Concerning State Contracting For State Employee Health Insurance Coverage And Other Related Services.
description: To require additional notices to the Comptroller, the legislative leaders and Health Care Cost Containment Committee concerning the potential termination of participating provider agreements in the employee health insurance plan and to prohibit certain entities that terminate participating provider agreements from participating in future competitive selection processes for a period of time.

title: An Act Concerning The Community Investment Fund Board.
description: To permit members of the Community Investment Fund Board to designate proxies to act in their place when they cannot attend a meeting.

title: An Act Requiring A Plan For The Translation And Review Of Forms And Applications Required To Access State Agency Services Or Benefits By Limited-english Proficient Individuals.
description: To require (1) the Commissioner of Administrative Services to develop a plan for the translation and review of certain forms and applications into languages spoken by limited-English proficient individuals in the state, and (2) state agencies to adopt and implement such plan and appoint a language access coordinator.

title: An Act Requiring Notification To The Legislative Leaders Of The Proposed Adoption Of Agency Regulations And The State Building And Fire Codes.
description: To require state agencies to provide electronic notification to the legislative leaders when they begin the process of adopting regulations, the State Building Code, Fire Prevention Code and Fire Safety Code.

title: An Act Establishing A Task Force To Study The Operations Of The Department Of Consumer Protection.
description: To establish a task force to study the operations of the Department of Consumer Protection.

title: An Act Concerning Cannabis, Hemp And Infused Beverage Regulation.
description: To (1) replace "marijuana" with "cannabis", (2) redefine "cannabis", (3) authorize qualifying out-of-state patients to access the state's palliative use cannabis market, (4) provide that facility from borrowing money or receiving credit from a cultivator, micro-cultivator or producer for more than thirty days, (7) authorize the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to order a cultivator, micro-cultivator or producer to issue a written notice of delinquency for any delinquent retailer, hybrid retailer or dispensary facility, (8) require the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to adopt regulations to (A) establish additional licenses and endorsements, and (B) allow for sales of additional palliative use cannabis products to consumers at retailers and hybrid retailers, (9) require the Social Equity Council to review and approve certain sales or transfers involving cannabis establishment licenses issued to social equity applicants, (10) require the consumer protection, (11) provide that no retailer, hybrid retailer or dispensary facility shall retain any personal data obtained for purposes of age verification for longer than twenty-four hours, (12) eliminate provisions requiring a hybrid retailer to (A) maintain a pharmacist at its hybrid retailer location, (B) offer pharmacist consultations, and (C) maintain a private consultation space for pharmacists, (13) allow edible cannabis products to exceed five milligrams of THC in certain circumstances, (14) eliminate the dosage, potency and concentration limits for cannabis concentrates,
