(3) provide (A) that certain uses of an automated employment-related decision process constitute an unlawful discriminatory practice, (B) that no artificial intelligence technology shall be used to modify or impair a collective bargaining agreement or the role of a designated employee organization, (C) for the designation of artificial intelligence fellows, and (D) for the inclusion of instruction in topics such as the responsible use of emerging technologies in teacher certification preparation programs; and (4) modify (A) the "computer science education and workforce development account", (B) the Technology Talent and Innovation Fund Advisory Committee, and (C) the economic development strategic plan.

title: An Act Concerning Supports For Children And Families.
description: To improve the well-being of children and families.

title: An Act Concerning Educational Equity.
description: To increase funding for public schools.

title: An Act Supporting Graduate Students In The State.
description: To establish the Supplemental Graduate Student Loan Program, allow up to ten million dollars in state bonds for said program, allocate not less than sixty million dollars in annual private activity bonds for the Connecticut Higher Education Supplemental Loan Authority and increase the authority's bonding authorization cap.

title: An Act Supporting Commuters And Microtransit Services.
description: To provide funding for on-demand microtransit services in the state.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The Probate Courts.
description: To fund an increase in court-appointed conservator compensation to align with the increase in minimum wage in accordance with the recommendations of the working group convened under section 7 of public act 25-48.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The Preapprenticeship Grant Program.
description: To provide funding for the high school preapprenticeship grant program.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The Shore Line East Rail Line.
description: To provide funding to increase the Shore Line East rail service between the city of New Haven and the town of Mystic in order to ease traffic congestion on Interstate Route 95 and promote tourism along the Connecticut shoreline during the summer.

title: An Act Concerning The Calculation Of State Forest Land In Certain Municipalities For Purposes Of Grants In Lieu Of Taxes Payments.
description: To calculate the value of state forest land, for purposes of grants in lieu of taxes payments by the state to municipalities, as real property for any municipality in which over fifty per cent of the land within such municipality's boundaries is state forest.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The State-wide Narcotics Task Force.
description: To provide funding to combat the illegal manufacturing and sale of fentanyl in Hartford, New Haven, Bridgeport and Waterbury.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For Elderly Nutrition.
description: To increase funding for elderly nutrition.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The Easy Breathing Asthma Program.
description: To provide funding for the Easy Breathing asthma program.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The Removal Of Pfas From Fire Apparatus.
description: To provide funding to municipalities, fire companies and state entities to remove PFAS from fire apparatus.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For Autism Spectrum Disorder Services.
description: To increase funding for the Autism Spectrum Disorder waiver program to help alleviate the lengthy wait list.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For School-based Mental Health Services In Certain Rural Areas.
description: To offset decreases in federal funding for school-based mental health services in the northwest part of the state.

title: An Act Increasing The Per Diem Rate For Members Of The State Board Of Labor Relations.
description: To increase the per diem rate for regular and alternate members of the State Board of Labor Relations.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The Disposal Of Debris From The Mouth Of The Housatonic River.
description: To provide funding for the disposal of surface debris from the mouth of the Housatonic River.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The Youth Service Bureaus Enhancement Grant Program.
description: To provide additional grant funding for youth service bureaus.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For Youth Service Bureau Data Reporting.
description: To provide data on youth service bureaus.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The Office Of Dyslexia And Reading Disabilities.
description: To provide an operating budget for the Office of Dyslexia and Reading Disabilities.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The Preapprenticeship Grant Program.
description: To fully fund the preapprenticeship grant program and award each student who successfully completes the program not less than one thousand dollars.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For Municipalities For Early Voting Costs.
description: To make municipalities whole for the increased cost of administering early voting.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For Rural Hospitals.
description: To provide residents in rural communities with vital health care services.

title: An Act Requiring Funding For Regional Fire Training Schools Through Appropriations In The State Budget.
description: To fund the nine regional fire training schools through appropriations in the state budget and not from any specific taxes or increased surcharges, including any fees on insurance premiums.

title: An Act Eliminating Certain Funding For Peoplesbank Arena And The City Of Hartford And Increasing Funding For School Resource Officers.
description: To provide funding for school safety programs in all towns and cities in the state by reducing certain state funding for PeoplesBank Arena and the city of Hartford.

title: An Act Reducing Noneducation Aid To The City Of Hartford.
description: To reverse the fiscal impact to the state of the debt service agreement between the state and the city of Hartford.

title: An Act Increasing The Bond Authorization For The Connecticut Bioscience Innovation Fund.
description: To increase funding for bioscience innovation.

title: An Act Concerning The Learn Here, Live Here Program.
description: To increase the annual expenditure on the Learn Here, Live Here program to not more than five million dollars and to make such program available only to individuals whose income is seventy-five thousand dollars or less.

title: An Act Requiring The Establishment Of The Learn Here, Live Here Program, Increasing The Annual Expenditure On Such Program And Making Such Program Available To Certain Individuals.
description: To: (1) Require the establishment of the Learn Here, Live Here program; (2) increase the annual expenditure on such program to not more than five million dollars; and (3) make such program available only to individuals whose annual federal adjusted gross income is not more than seventy-five thousand dollars.

title: An Act Concerning An Increase Of The Foundation Amount For Purposes Of The Education Cost-sharing Grant.
description: To provide property tax relief.

title: An Act Concerning Full Reimbursement Of A School District's Excess Cost For Special Education.
description: To make school districts whole under the special education excess cost grant.

title: An Act Decreasing The Passport To The Parks Fee And Increasing The Nonresident Parking Pass Fee At Any State Park.
description: To reduce motor vehicle registration fees for Connecticut residents and increase the nonresident parking pass at any state park, forest, boat launch or other state recreational facility.

title: An Act Eliminating The Application Fee For Health Care Professionals Seeking Licensure By The Department Of Public Health And Capping The Licensure Fee For Such Professionals At Two Hundred Dollars.
description: To eliminate the application fee for public health care professionals seeking licensure by the Department of Public Health and cap the licensure fee for such professionals at two hundred dollars.

title: An Act Establishing A Capital Gains Tax On Certain Endowment Funds Of Institutions Of Higher Education And Concerning The Use Of The Revenue Generated.
description: To impose a capital gains tax on certain endowment funds of institutions of higher education and dedicate the revenue from such tax to reducing the amount that participants in the Paid Family and Medical Leave Insurance Program are required to contribute under section 31-49g of the general statutes.

title: An Act Requiring The Indexing Of Income Thresholds For The Personal Income Tax.
description: To require that income thresholds for the personal income tax be adjusted in accordance with any change in the consumer price index.

title: An Act Establishing A Tax Credit For Educational Access And Opportunity Scholarships.
description: To establish a tax credit for donations made to nonprofit entities that provide educational access and opportunity scholarships.

title: An Act Establishing A Personal Income Tax Deduction For Certain Taxpayers For Certain Capital Gains On The Sale Of A Primary Home.
description: To establish a personal income tax deduction, for taxpayers sixty-five years of age or older, for the amount of any capital gain on the sale of a primary home that is includable in gross income for federal income tax purposes.

title: An Act Establishing A Medicare Premiums Tax Credit Against The Personal Income Tax.
description: To establish a credit against the personal income tax for premiums paid by a taxpayer for a taxable year for Medicare and Medicare Advantage plans.

title: An Act Concerning The Tax Credit For Machinery And Equipment.
description: To replace the current tax credit for machinery and equipment with a tax credit for fifty per cent of the amount spent by a corporation on machinery and equipment acquired for and installed in a facility in this state and including a five-year minimum use and recapture provision.

title: An Act Concerning The Qualifying Income Thresholds For The Social Security Benefits Deduction From The Personal Income Tax.
description: To increase the qualifying income thresholds for the full Social Security benefits deduction from the personal income tax.

title: An Act Concerning The Higher Sales And Use Taxes Rate Applicable To Certain Motor Vehicles.
description: To (1) increase to more than seventy-five thousand dollars the sales price threshold for a motor vehicle subject to the seven and three-fourths per cent sales and use taxes rate, and (2) exempt commercial vehicles from the higher sales and use taxes rate.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State To Restore The Historic Train Station In The Town Of Wallingford.
description: To provide funding for the restoration and conversion of the historic train station in the town of Wallingford for the benefit of the local economy and community.

title: An Act Establishing A Personal Income Tax Deduction For Tips Or Gratuities.
description: To establish a personal income tax deduction of up to twenty-five thousand dollars for the amount of tips or gratuities declared by a taxpayer employed in certain occupations.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Purchase Of Automatic External Defibrillators At Schools.
description: To provide funding to schools for the purchase of automatic external defibrillators.

title: An Act Eliminating The Highway Use Tax.
description: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: An Act Establishing A Personal Income Tax Deduction For Stipends Paid To Certain Volunteer Firefighters Or Volunteer Ambulance Members.
description: To establish a personal income tax deduction for any stipend paid to certain volunteer firefighters or volunteer ambulance members by a municipality, volunteer fire department or volunteer ambulance association.

title: An Act Concerning The Research And Development Tax Credit Exchange Rate For Biotechnology Companies.
description: To increase the research and development tax credit exchange rate under section 12-217ee of the general statutes to one hundred per cent for biotechnology companies.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Plainfield Veterans Of Foreign Wars Post 5446.
description: To provide funding for renovations in compliance with physical accessibility guidelines under the federal Americans with Disabilities Act at the Plainfield Veterans of Foreign Wars Post 5466.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Establishment Of A Garden At York Correctional Institution.
description: To provide funding for a garden at York Correctional Institution to grow fresh produce for the inmates.

title: An Act Establishing A Personal Income Tax Deduction For College Tuition Payments Made By A Taxpayer.
description: To establish a personal income tax deduction for college tuition payments made by the taxpayer.

title: An Act Dedicating The Additional Sales Tax On Meals To Certain Purposes.
description: To dedicate the revenue generated from the additional one per cent of sales tax on meals as follows: (1) Fifty per cent of the amount collected to be deposited in the Tourism Fund; (2) twenty-five per cent of the amount collected to be paid to the municipalities to which the purchases of the meals are sourced; and (3) twenty-five per cent of the amount collected to be deposited in the General Fund and dedicated to funding free school lunches.

title: An Act Establishing A Personal Income Tax Deduction For Public Benefit Charges Paid By Taxpayers On Their Utility Bills.
description: To establish a personal income tax deduction for the total amount of public benefit charges paid for a taxable year by a taxpayer on their utility bills.

title: An Act Concerning The Sales Price Threshold Of Motor Vehicles Subject To A Higher Sales And Use Taxes Rate.
description: To (1) increase to more than sixty-five thousand dollars the sales price threshold for a motor vehicle subject to the seven and three-fourths per cent sales and use taxes rate, and (2) index the sales price to reflect the rate of inflation.

title: An Act Restoring The Cap On A Combined Group's Tax Liability On A Unitary Basis.
description: To restore the cap of two million five hundred thousand dollars on a combined group's tax liability on a unitary basis.

title: An Act Concerning The Cannabis Total Thc Tax.
description: To replace the cannabis tax based on total THC with a flat excise tax.

title: An Act Concerning The Sales And Use Taxes Rate.
description: To (1) decrease the sales and use taxes rate to six per cent, and (2) eliminate the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by eating establishments, caterers or grocery stores.

title: An Act Establishing A Voluntary Employer Payroll Tax And A Personal Income Tax Credit For Certain Employees.
description: To establish a voluntary employer payroll tax and a personal income tax credit for certain employees of an employer that elects to pay such tax.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Enhancement And Extension Of High-speed Broadband Internet Access In Rural Communities.
description: To provide funding to improve access to quality Internet and cellular telephone service in rural communities.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Remediation Of Fill Pile Waste Contamination In The Town Of Fairfield.
description: To provide funding for the remediation of waste contamination associated with the fill pile in the town of Fairfield.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Connecticut Air And Space Center In The Town Of Stratford.
description: To provide funding for renovations to the Connecticut Air and Space Center in the town of Stratford to expand the educational and community use of said center.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Improvements To The Town Hall In The Town Of Stafford.
description: To provide funding for improvements to the town hall in the town of Stafford that comply with the physical accessibility guidelines under the federal Americans with Disabilities Act.

title: An Act Establishing A Temporary Personal Income Tax Deduction For Tips Or Gratuities.
description: To establish a temporary personal income tax deduction of up to twenty-five thousand dollars for the amount of tips or gratuities declared by certain taxpayers for the taxable years commencing on or after January 1, 2026, and prior to January 1, 2029.

title: An Act Establishing A Cap On The Aggregate Amount Of Personal Income Tax Revenue The State May Collect.
description: To establish a cap on the amount of aggregate personal income tax revenue that the state may collect, with any amount collected in excess of such cap to be refunded to taxpayers on a pro rata basis.

title: An Act Restoring The Rate Of The Credit Against The Affected Business Entity Tax.
description: To restore the rate of the credit against the affected business entity tax to ninety-three and one-hundredths per cent.

title: An Act Eliminating The Earned Income Tax Credit.
description: To eliminate the earned income tax credit.

title: An Act Exempting Social Security Benefits And Pension Or Annuity Income From The Personal Income Tax.
description: To exempt Social Security benefits and pension or annuity income for all taxpayers from the personal income tax.

title: An Act Establishing A Tax Credit For Premium Payments For Certain Long-term Care Insurance Policies.
description: To establish a tax credit for the amount of premiums paid to purchase an individual or group long-term care insurance policy that provides benefits for health care provided in an insured's home.

title: An Act Eliminating State Taxes Or Fees For Which Collection Costs Exceed The Revenue Received.
description: To eliminate any state tax or fee for which the cost of collection exceeds the revenue received by the state from the imposition of such tax or fee.

title: An Act Establishing A Nonrefundable Personal Income Tax Credit For The Purchase Of A Gun Safe.
description: To establish a nonrefundable credit against the personal income tax of up to one hundred fifty dollars for the purchase of a gun safe for personal use.

title: An Act Establishing A Tax Credit For Dairy Farmers.
description: To establish a tax credit in the amount of twenty million dollars in the aggregate for dairy farmers, to offset cyclical downturns in milk prices paid to such farmers.

title: An Act Establishing A Caregiver Tax Credit Against The Personal Income Tax.
description: To establish a caregiver tax credit against the personal income tax.

title: An Act Establishing A Child And Dependent Tax Credit Against The Personal Income Tax.
description: To establish a child and dependent tax credit against the personal income tax of five hundred dollars per eligible child and dependent.

title: An Act Establishing A Personal Income Tax Deduction For Full-time Home Health Care Costs.
description: To establish a personal income tax deduction of up to sixty thousand dollars for the cost of full-time home health care, including, but not limited to, the cost of medical supplies and in-home services.

title: An Act Eliminating The Qualifying Income Thresholds For The Personal Income Tax Deductions For Social Security Benefits.
description: To eliminate the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits.

title: An Act Prohibiting State Agencies From Charging Service Fees For Payments Made By Certain Means.
description: To prohibit state agencies from charging payors a service fee for payment by means of a credit card, charge card or debit card.

title: An Act Increasing The Amount Of The Personal Income Tax Deduction For Contributions To State-established 529 Qualified State Tuition Programs.
description: To increase the amount of the personal income tax deduction for contributions to accounts for 529 qualified state tuition programs established and maintained by the state.

title: An Act Concerning The Privatization Of The Department Of Motor Vehicles.
description: To save the state money and improve efficiencies by privatizing the Department of Motor Vehicles.

title: An Act Concerning The Cost Of Occupational Licenses.
description: To (1) eliminate all application fees charged by state occupational licensing boards, and (2) cap the amount the state may charge for an occupational license at one hundred dollars.

title: An Act Establishing The Federal Cuts Response Fund.
description: An Act Establishing The Federal Cuts Response Fund.

title: An Act Concerning Revenue Items To Implement The Governor's Budget.
description: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: An Act Authorizing And Adjusting Bonds Of The State And Establishing A Supplemental Graduate Student Loan Program.
description: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: An Act Addressing Innovations In And The Responsible Use Of Artificial Intelligence.
description: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: An Act Strengthening Nonprofits.
description: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: An Act Requiring Insurance Coverage For Scalp Cooling.
description: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: An Act Updating Prison Rape Elimination Standards.
description: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: An Act Revising And Consolidating The Hate Crimes Statutes.
description: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: An Act Enhancing The Investigative Authority Of The Inspector General And Establishing Protected Areas.
description: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: An Act Establishing Additional Protections For Warehouse Workers.
description: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: An Act Implementing The Rural Health Transformation Program To Expand Health Care Access.
description: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For Children's Mental Health.
description: To increase funding for children's mental health in southeastern Connecticut.

title: An Act Establishing A Credit Against The Personal Income Tax For Certain Employees Of Defense Contractors And Of Direct Suppliers And Subcontractors Of Defense Contractors.
description: To establish a credit against the personal income tax of five hundred dollars for certain employees of defense contractors and of direct suppliers and subcontractors of defense contractors.

title: An Act Establishing Tax Credits For Grocery Stores Built In Low-income Areas.
description: To establish tax credits for grocery stores built in low-income areas with limited access to groceries.

title: An Act Establishing A Credit Against The Personal Income Tax For Donated Food.
description: To establish a credit against the personal income tax of twenty-five per cent of the value of food donated by a taxpayer for a taxable year.

title: An Act Establishing A Connecticut Dairy Farmer Tax Credit.
description: To establish a tax credit for dairy farmers in the state.

title: An Act Establishing A Refundable Credit Against The Personal Income Tax For The Amount Of Motor Vehicle Property Tax Paid.
description: To (1) establish a refundable credit against the personal income tax for the amount of motor vehicle property tax paid for a taxable year by taxpayers with adjusted gross income of less than one hundred thousand dollars for single filers and less than two hundred thousand dollars for married individuals filing jointly, and (2) limit the credit under section 12-704c of the general statutes to property tax paid on primary residences.

title: An Act Reducing Certain Personal Income Tax Marginal Rates.
description: To reduce the two lowest marginal rates for the personal income tax from (1) two per cent to zero, and (2) from four and one-half per cent to three per cent, for taxpayers with adjusted gross income of less than one hundred thousand dollars for single filers and less than two hundred thousand dollars for married individuals filing jointly.

title: An Act Establishing A State-wide Property Tax On Certain Residential Real Property.
description: To establish a state-wide property tax on residential real property with assessed values of more than three million dollars.

title: An Act Concerning The Distribution Of The Sales And Use Taxes Imposed On Meals Sold By An Eating Establishment, Caterer Or Grocery Store.
description: To provide that the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store be distributed to the municipalities in which the revenue was generated.

title: An Act Establishing A Refundable Child Tax Credit.
description: To establish a refundable child tax credit.

title: An Act Establishing A Capital Gains Surcharge.
description: To establish a capital gains surcharge on certain taxpayers.

title: An Act Eliminating Various Occupational And Professional License, Permit, Certification And Registration Fees.
description: To eliminate various occupational and professional license, permit, certification and registration fees.

title: An Act Exempting Dog Grooming Services From The Sales And Use Taxes.
description: To exempt dog grooming services from the sales and use taxes.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Improvements To The Athletic Fields For Regional School District 8.
description: To provide funding to Regional School District 8 for improvements to the athletic fields.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State To Improve Dams, Culverts, Bridges And Waterways In The Town Of Ledyard.
description: To provide funding to improve the dams, culverts, bridges and waterways on Long Pond, Bush Pond and other related waterways in the town of Ledyard.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Rehabilitation Of Utilities Associated With Connecting Norwich Public Works Through The Former Norwich State Hospital Property And Extending To The Preston Incinerator Site.
description: To provide funding to rehabilitate and upgrade the utilities associated with connecting Norwich Public Works through the former Norwich State Hospital property and extending to the Preston Incinerator site.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State To Address The Contamination Of Wells In The Town Of Franklin.
description: To provide funding to assist the town of Franklin to address the contamination of wells associated with the Franklin Town Hall and at the Franklin Volunteer Fire Department.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Water Lines And Necessary Equipment In The Town Of Hebron.
description: To provide funding for water lines and necessary equipment in the town of Hebron to support new housing.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Improvements To Lisbon Central School In The Town Of Lisbon.
description: To provide funding for upgrades to the gym and associated areas and the heating, ventilation and air conditioning system at Lisbon Central School in the town of Lisbon.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Farms Associated With New Anaerobic Digesters To Provide Necessary Changes To Manure Management Systems.
description: To provide funding for farms associated with new anaerobic digesters for the purpose of providing the necessary changes to manure management systems.

title: An Act Eliminating The Qualifying Income Thresholds For The Personal Income Tax Deductions For Social Security Benefits.
description: To eliminate the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits.

title: An Act Exempting Covid-19 At-home Test Kits From The Sales And Use Taxes.
description: To exempt COVID-19 at-home test kits from the sales and use taxes.

title: An Act Concerning The Prevention Of Human Trafficking.
description: To (1) require the Commissioner of Revenue Services to periodically disclose to the Commissioner of Consumer Protection the name and address of each operator of a hotel, lodging house or bed and breakfast establishment who has remitted the use tax, (2) impose penalties on operators of hotels, motels, inns or similar lodgings who fail to satisfy various recordkeeping, training, occupancy rate and notice requirements, and (3) grant additional enforcement powers to the Commissioner of Consumer Protection.

title: An Act Concerning Breaches Of Security Involving Electronic Personal Information.
description: To (1) provide that certain materials provided to the Attorney General following a breach of security involving electronic personal information shall be provided to the Attorney General in a form and manner prescribed by the Attorney General, (2) define "massive breach of security", (3) require a third-party forensic examination, analysis and report following a massive breach of security, and (4) impose an additional penalty for any person who fails to submit a third-party forensic report to the Attorney General following a massive breach of security.

title: An Act Concerning Baby Food Products And Toxic Heavy Metals.
description: To prohibit the manufacture, sale, distribution or offering for sale of, and require testing, disclosures and reporting concerning, baby food products containing toxic heavy metals.

title: An Act Concerning Used Motor Vehicle Warranties.
description: To provide that (1) a dealer selling a used motor vehicle that is less than ten years of age shall not exclude, modify, disclaim or limit an implied warranty on the vehicle, (2) each contract entered into by a dealer for the sale of any such used motor vehicle to a consumer shall include an express warranty that the vehicle is mechanically sound and will remain so for at least sixty days or three thousand miles of operation, whichever occurs first, and (3) a used motor vehicle may be sold "as is" by a dealer only if the vehicle is ten years of age or older.

title: An Act Suspending Inflation Cost Limitations For Intermediate Care Facilities.
description: To reduce financial burdens on intermediate care facilities funded under the Medicaid program.

title: An Act Exempting Certain Active Duty Service Members From Paying Fees For Any Motor Vehicle Operator's License And Registration.
description: To exempt active duty service members who were not residents of Connecticut at the time of induction from paying fees for motor vehicle operator's licenses and registrations.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of Long-term Care Needs.
description: To require the Commissioner of Social Services to study long-term care needs in the state.

title: An Act Requiring Public Hearings For Certain Rate Increases At Assisted Living Facilities.
description: To require each assisted living services agency to hold a public informational hearing when the agency increases a fee by more than ten per cent of the previous fee.

title: An Act Concerning The Department Of Aging And Disability Services' Recommendations Regarding Municipal Agents For Aging.
description: To (1) require municipal agents to (A) be free of any conflict of interest or perceived conflict of interest, (B) certify in writing the absence of any such conflict, and (C) inform the appointing authority of the existence of any such conflict if one arises, and (2) allow municipalities to jointly appoint municipal agents.

title: An Act Restricting Private Equity Ownership Of Nursing Homes.
description: To restrict private equity ownership of nursing homes.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For Connecticut Public Television.
description: To fund children's programming.

title: An Act Increasing Funding For Higher Education.
description: To provide more funding for higher education and allow more Connecticut students to be able to afford college.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For Community Action Agencies.
description: To provide critical funding to local community action agencies and protect the people the agencies serve.

title: An Act Increasing Funding For Dairy Farmers.
description: To provide funding for dairy farmer stabilization.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The Dairy Industry.
description: To provide funding to protect the dairy industry.

title: An Act Concerning Manufacturing.
description: To require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to study the needs of manufacturers in the state.

title: An Act Establishing The Connecticut-germany Trade Commission.
description: To establish a Connecticut-Germany Trade Commission.

title: An Act Establishing The Connecticut-india Trade Commission.
description: To establish a Connecticut-India Trade Commission.

title: An Act Establishing An Airport Development Zone In The Town Of Plainville.
description: To require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to establish an airport development zone in the town of Plainville.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Technical Education And Career System.
description: To (1) transfer certain duties of the Technical Education and Career System board to the executive director of the Technical Education and Career System, (2) remove reference to the "division of postsecondary education programs", (3) allow the board to recommend multiple candidates for superintendent of the Technical Education and Career System at one time, and (4) remove the three-year term limit and performance evaluation requirement for and amend the duties of the superintendent.

title: An Act Concerning Public Education In The State.
description: To require the Department of Education to conduct a study of public education in Connecticut.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Office Of Early Childhood.
description: To implement the recommendations of the Office of Early Childhood.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Department Of Education.
description: To implement the recommendations of the Department of Education.

title: An Act Increasing The Appropriation For The Special Education And Expansion Development Grant.
description: To support students with special education needs and protect school districts from volatility in special education expenditures.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Capital Improvements To Vinal Technical High School In The Town Of Middleton.
description: To provide funding for capital improvements to Vinal Technical High School in the town of Middletown.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State To Complete The Installation Of A Generator For Regional School District Number 8.
description: To provide funding for Regional School District Number 8 to complete the installation of a generator for the creation of a regional shelter.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Expansion Of The Cafeteria At Ledyard Middle School In The Town Of Ledyard.
description: To provide funding to the town of Ledyard to expand the cafeteria at Ledyard Middle School to accommodate the students at meal times.

title: An Act Entitling Towns To Full Reimbursement Under The Excess Cost Grant.
description: To ensure that towns receive full reimbursement under the excess cost grant for special education.

title: An Act Providing For Local Representation On The Connecticut Siting Council.
description: To provide local representation on the Connecticut Siting Council.

title: An Act Studying The Remediation Of Hydrilla In State Lakes And The Expediting Of Permits Related To Such Remediation.
description: To examine the most effective methods and protocols for the remediation of hydrilla in state lakes, including ways to expedite permits for such remediation.

title: An Act Concerning The Protection Of Crops And Livestock From Certain Wildlife.
description: To authorize the taking of certain wildlife that injure or kill livestock or that caused crop damage in the preceding growing season.

title: An Act Concerning A Study On The Need For Extended Producer Responsibility For Solar Panels And Vapes And Including Aerosol Paints Under The Paint Stewardship Program.
description: To study the need for extended producer responsibility programs for solar panels and vapes and to include aerosol paints under the paint stewardship program.

title: An Act Concerning Revisions To Aquaculture-related Statutes.
description: To clarify the notification procedure for designation of shellfish areas that are closed to harvesting due to contamination or pollution.

title: An Act Concerning Revisions To The Farmers' Market Nutrition Program.
description: To revise the Farmers' Market Nutrition Program statutes to reflect procedures and terms currently used in the administration of such program.

title: An Act Concerning The Legislative Commissioners' Recommendations For Technical Revisions To The Higher Education Statutes.
description: To make technical revisions to the higher education statutes.

title: An Act Prohibiting Certain Land Use And Zoning Limitations On Housing.
description: To prohibit local jurisdictions from (1) adopting or enforcing certain zoning provisions relating to lot size, dimensions, setback requirements, lot coverage and design or architectural elements for certain single–family homes; (2) proscribing certain housing types in certain zones; and (3) proscribing certain subdivisions of certain lot types.

title: An Act Appropriating Funds For Rental Assistance Program Housing Inspections.
description: To appropriate funds to the Department of Housing for the purpose of hiring additional full-time rental home inspectors for the rental assistance program.

title: An Act Expanding Medicaid Eligibility For Older Adults With Disabilities.
description: To expand Medicaid eligibility for older adults with disabilities by disregarding certain income.

title: An Act Requiring Certain Agencies To Report Costs Associated With Programs Serving Children And Families.
description: To require the Department of Social Services and the Department of Developmental Services to submit reports describing current costs associated with programs serving children and families and anticipated costs associated with utilizing different eligibility criteria for participation in such programs.

title: An Act Concerning The Recommendations Of The Department Of Children And Families.
description: To (1) consolidate existing Department of Children and Families reporting requirements concerning the department's services, compliance with statutory requirements, facilities operated by the department, reports of animal harm, neglect or cruelty, the department's family assessment response program, private providers that contract with the department, foster care services and licensing and diversion of children from the juvenile justice and court systems, (2) add a reporting requirement concerning cost savings resulting from the implementation of the Behavioral Health Partnership, (3) eliminate a reporting requirement concerning children missing or abducted from the custody of the department, and (4) make technical and conforming changes.

title: An Act Establishing A Task Force To Study The Voluntary Surrender Of Infants.
description: To establish a task force to study the voluntary surrender of infants.

title: An Act Concerning Municipal Camp Safety.
description: To require (1) certain employees of municipal youth camps to be mandated reporters, and (2) the Office of Early Childhood to submit a report concerning municipal youth camps.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Staywell Health Center In The City Of Waterbury.
description: To provide funding for capital improvements to StayWell Health Center in the city Waterbury.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State To Extend The Sprague Streetscape Project In The Town Of Sprague.
description: To provide funding to the town of Sprague to extend the Sprague Streetscape Project.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Purchases And Projects At The Baltic Fire Engine Company In The Town Of Sprague.
description: To provide funding to complete purchases and projects at the Baltic Fire Engine Company in the town of Sprague.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Marlborough Fire Department In The Town Of Marlborough.
description: To provide funding to complete purchases and projects at the Marlborough Fire Department in the town of Marlborough.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State To The Southeastern Connecticut Water Authority To Upgrade Waterlines And Connections In The Town Of Montville.
description: To provide financial assistance to the Southeastern Connecticut Water Authority to upgrade waterlines and connections in Montville Manor in the town of Montville.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Improvements To Doubleday Road In The Town Of Columbia.
description: To provide funding for improvements to Doubleday Road in the town of Columbia.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Implementation And Construction Of A Sewer And Water Line In The Town Of Franklin.
description: To provide funding for the implementation and construction of a sewer and water line in the town of Franklin.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Expansion Of Bill Library In The Town Of Ledyard.
description: To provide funding for the expansion of the Bill Library in the town of Ledyard.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For A Radio Dispatch System For The Fire Departments In The Town Of Montville.
description: To provide funding for a radio dispatch system for the fire departments in the town of Montville.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Plans And Designs To Remove Old Papermill Pond Dam In The Town Of Sprague.
description: To provide funding for the development of plans and designs to remove Old Papermill Pond Dam in the town of Sprague.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For A Sewer Expansion Project In The Fitchville Section Of The Town Of Bozrah.
description: To provide funding for a sewer expansion project in the Fitchville section of the town of Bozrah.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State To Purchase Camp Laurel And Rehabilitate The Dam In The Town Of Lebanon.
description: To provide funding to purchase Camp Laurel and rehabilitate the dam in the town of Lebanon.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Completion Of Recreational Fields And Meeting Areas At The American Legion Post 85 In The Town Of Sprague.
description: To provide funding to the American Legion Post 85 in the town of Sprague for the completion of recreational fields and meeting areas.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Renovation, Rehabilitation And Update Of Recreational Fields In The Village Of Baltic.
description: To provide funding for the renovation, rehabilitation and update of recreational fields in the village of Baltic in the town of Sprague.

title: N Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Renovations To St. Mary Of The Immaculate Conception In The Village Of Baltic.
description: To provide funding to St. Mary of the Immaculate Conception in the village of Baltic in the town of Sprague for renovations to the bell tower and other structures.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For A Multimodal Track On A Portion Of Connecticut Route 117.
description: To provide funding to the town of Ledyard for a multimodal track on Connecticut Route 117 to the Groton town line.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For A Planning Grant To Expand And Install Sewer Lines In The Town Of Ledyard.
description: To provide funding for a planning grant to expand and install sewer lines in the town of Ledyard.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Student Housing At The Avery Point Campus Of The University Of Connecticut.
description: To provide funding for student housing at the Avery Point Campus of The University of Connecticut and increase the student population.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For A Sewer Project In The Village Of Hanover.
description: To provide funding for the installation of a force main and sewer lines in the village of Hanover in the town of Sprague and replace existing lines that are over one hundred years old, collapsing and causing sewer backup into residential homes.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Construction Of A Police Station In The City Of Norwich.
description: To provide sixty-seven per cent of the funding necessary for the construction of a police station in the city of Norwich.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Construction Of A Fire Station In The City Of Middletown.
description: To provide funding for the construction of a fire station to ensure adequate fire protection in the Newfield Street corridor in the city of Middletown.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Capital Improvements At Middlesex Community College.
description: To provide funding for capital improvements at Middlesex Community College in the city of Middletown.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Integrated Day Charter School In The City Of Norwich.
description: To provide funding for capital improvements at the Integrated Day Charter School in the city of Norwich.

title: An Act Concerning Personal Income Tax Refunds.
description: To require moneys to be transferred from the Budget Reserve Fund to the General Fund and used to provide personal income tax refunds to taxpayers.

title: An Act Concerning The Personal Income Tax Deductions For Social Security Benefits.
description: To exempt Social Security benefits for all taxpayers from the personal income tax or require the qualifying income thresholds for personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits be adjusted in accordance with any change in the consumer price index.

title: An Act Establishing A Personal Income Tax Deduction For Certain Gambling Losses.
description: To establish a personal income tax deduction for gambling losses incurred by a taxpayer, to offset any taxable winnings.

title: An Act Exempting Certain Articles Of Clothing From The Sales And Use Taxes.
description: To exempt articles of clothing costing under one hundred dollars from the sales and use taxes.

title: An Act Exempting Small Businesses From The Sales And Use Taxes On Electricity And Natural Gas.
description: To exempt from the sales and use taxes the sale of electricity and natural gas to small businesses.

title: An Act Establishing A Refundable Credit Against The Personal Income Tax For Volunteer First Responders.
description: To establish a refundable credit against the personal income tax for volunteer first responders.

title: An Act Concerning The Distribution Of The Sales And Use Taxes Imposed On Meals Sold By An Eating Establishment, Caterer Or Grocery Store.
description: To provide that the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store be distributed to the municipalities in which the revenue was generated.

title: An Act Revising The Calculation Of The Hospital Tax.
description: To revise the calculation of the hospital tax to be based on the number of Medicaid, Medicare and uninsured patients served.

title: An Act Eliminating The Qualifying Income Thresholds For The Personal Income Tax Deductions For Social Security Benefits.
description: To eliminate the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits.

title: An Act Authorizing Certain Foreign-educated Veterinarians To Practice Under A Temporary Permit And The Establishment Of A Veterinarian-client-patient Relationship Through The Use Of Telehealth For The Treatment Of Urgent Medical Conditions.
description: To expand access to veterinary services in the state.

title: An Act Concerning The Psychedelic-assisted Therapy Pilot Program.
description: To expand access to and extend the psychedelic-assisted therapy pilot program.

title: An Act Concerning Patient Protections And Standards Of Care At Connecticut Valley Hospital.
description: To require the Commissioner of Mental Health and Addiction Services to keep persons undergoing psychiatric evaluation at Connecticut Valley Hospital separated according to biological sex at all times.

title: An Act Establishing Licensure For Long-term Acute Care Hospitals.
description: To establish licensure for long-term acute care hospitals.

title: An Act Concerning Cardiac Screening And Sudden Cardiac Arrest Prevention For Certain Student Athletes.
description: To require cardiac screening of certain student athletes to prevent sudden cardiac arrest in such athletes.

title: An Act Concerning The Prevention Of Accidental Overdose Deaths And Improving Access To Treatment And Recovery Services For Substance Use Disorder.
description: To prevent accidental overdose deaths and improve access to treatment and recovery services for substance use disorder.

title: An Act Concerning Hospital Sale-leaseback Agreements And Attestations Concerning Lack Of Private Equity Control Of The Hospital And Control Of Or Interference With The Professional Judgment And Clinical Decisions Of Certain Health Care Providers.
description: To (1) permit hospitals experiencing financial distress to enter into sale-leaseback agreements under certain circumstances, and (2) require hospitals to submit attestations that no private equity entity has a controlling interest in the hospital or interferes with the professional judgment or clinical decision-making of certain health care providers.

title: An Act Providing A Family Caregiver Tax Credit.
description: To provide a tax credit to family caregivers for certain expenditures incurred for the care and support of elderly family members.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Development Of A Water Storage Facility In The Town Of South Windsor.
description: To provide funding for the development of a water storage facility in the town of South Windsor to support emergency responses to residential fires and other disasters, ensure a reliable water supply for farms and livestock, prepare for droughts and extreme weather events and address infrastructure gaps in rural parts of said town.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For The Restoration And Renovation Of The Pinney House In The Town Of Ellington.
description: To provide funding for the restoration and renovation of the historic Pinney House in the town of Ellington, support local historical education and provide civic space for residents.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For Renovations To The John J. Mitchell Fairgrounds In The Town Of South Windsor.
description: To provide funding to the town of South Windsor to renovate the John J. Mitchell Fairgrounds, including development of an event space for the community, installation of utilities and construction of a pavilion.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State To Establish A World War Ii Museum And Education Center In The Town Of East Hartford.
description: To provide funding to establish a Word War II museum and education center in the town of East Hartford to memorialize the contributions and sacrifices of the veterans of World War II.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State To Commemorate The Service And Sacrifice Of Philippine-american War Veterans.
description: To provide funding to commemorate the service and sacrifice of Philippine-American War veterans as part of the Connecticut State Veterans Memorial.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State To Upgrade Town Facility Technologies For The Expansion Of Municipal Veterans Services Programs.
description: To provide funding for technology upgrades at various town facilities to enable the expansion of municipal veterans services programs.

title: An Act Authorizing Bonds Of The State For A Skilled Trades Center At June Norcross Webster Scout Reservation.
description: To authorize bonds of the state to establish a skilled trades center at June Norcross Webster Scout Reservation.

title: An Act Dedicating A Portion Of The Revenue Generated From Sales And Use Taxes Imposed On Meals Sold By An Eating Establishment, Caterer Or Grocery Store To The Tourism Fund.
description: To require a percentage of the revenue generated from the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store be deposited in the Tourism Fund to support the hospitality, arts, culture and tourism needs of the state and related marketing endeavors.

title: An Act Exempting The Cost Of Headstones Up To A Certain Amount From The Sales And Use Taxes.
description: To exempt up to two thousand five hundred dollars of the cost of a headstone from the sales and use taxes.

title: An Act Exempting Overtime Income From The Personal Income Tax.
description: To exempt from the personal income tax the amount of any overtime income earned by an employee.

title: An Act Increasing The Minimum Average Commission Payable To Lottery Sales Agents.
description: To increase the minimum average commission payable to lottery sales agents.

title: An Act Increasing Medicaid Reimbursement Rates For Nephrology Services.
description: To increase Medicaid rates of reimbursement for nephrology services.

title: An Act Increasing Medicaid Rates For Pediatric Care.
description: To increase Medicaid reimbursement rates for pediatric care services.

title: An Act Appropriating Funds To Investigate And Enforce Conduct Relating To Health Insurance Practices.
description: To: (1) Expand the capacity of the office of the Attorney General to investigate and enforce conduct related to health insurance practices by health carriers that impact access to health care, inflate consumer costs or violate federal or state law; and (2) require that said office submit a report to the joint standing committees of the General Assembly having cognizance of matters relating to insurance and public health, not later than February 1, 2028, summarizing any such investigation or enforcement action taken by said office.

title: An Act Establishing A Tax Credit For Premium Payments For Certain Long-term Care Insurance Policies.
description: To establish a tax credit equal to any increase in premium costs that exceed two per cent of premiums paid annually to purchase an individual or group long-term care insurance policy during a taxable year, and allow long-term care policyholders to carry such credit over to future taxable years.

title: An Act Concerning Funding For The 9-8-8 Suicide Prevention And Mental Health Crisis Lifeline And The 2-1-1 Infoline Program.
description: To require dedicated funding for the 9-8-8 Suicide Prevention and Mental Health Crisis Lifeline and the 2-1-1 Infoline program.

title: An Act Concerning The Basic Property Tax Exemption For Veterans And Certain Other Military-related Individuals.
description: To (1) provide an increase in the exemption amount for property belonging to veterans and certain other military-related individuals, and (2) impose a cap on the value of any such property that would be eligible for such exemption.

title: An Act Concerning The Presumption Of Abandonment Of Certain Property Held Or Owing By A Banking Organization.
description: To establish certain exceptions to the presumption that demand or savings deposits made with banking organizations are presumed abandoned.

title: An Act Concerning The Community Bank And Credit Union Investment Program Established By The State Treasurer.
description: To establish that the State Treasurer may accept certain rates for investment-related services under the community bank and credit union investment program.

title: An Act Requiring Mortgagees To Accept Mortgage Payments Tendered On A Monthly, Semimonthly Or Biweekly Basis.
description: To require mortgagees to accept mortgage payments tendered on a monthly, semimonthly or biweekly basis.

title: An Act Requiring A Study Relating To Banking Issues In The State.
description: To require the Department of Banking to study and submit a report concerning banking issues in the state.

title: An Act Concerning Civil Penalties For Certain Violations Relating To Rental Security Deposits.
description: To establish that if the Banking Commissioner determines that any landlord has violated certain provisions concerning rental security deposits, the commissioner may, in accordance with sections 36a-50 and 36a-52 of the general statutes, order such landlord to pay a civil penalty not exceeding one hundred thousand dollars per violation, cease and desist from such practices and comply with certain provisions concerning rental security deposits.

title: An Act Concerning Student Literacy.
description: To establish and provide reading instruction and supports to all students in grades four to nine who are below proficient in reading.

title: An Act Concerning Aspiring Educators.
description: To expand eligibility under the aspiring educators scholarship program.

title: An Act Permitting Interscholastic Athletics To Be Used As Credit Toward The Physical Education Requirement For Purposes Of High School Graduation.
description: To permit students to use participation in interscholastic athletics to count as credit toward satisfying the physical education requirement of the high school graduation requirements.

title: An Act Concerning The Paraeducator Health Care Subsidy Program.
description: To clarify eligibility of paraeducators employed in public schools, including, but not limited to, charter schools, for the health care subsidy program.

title: An Act Exempting Ballots Cast At Elections, Primaries And Referenda From Disclosure Under The Freedom Of Information Act.
description: To exempt ballots cast at elections, primaries and referenda from disclosure under the Freedom of Information Act.

title: An Act Concerning Fees For Copying, Reviewing And Redacting Records Created By Police Body-worn Recording Equipment And Dashboard Cameras.
description: To authorize a public agency to charge a redaction fee for the disclosure of a record created by police body-worn equipment or dashboard cameras that contains portions not authorized to be disclosed under state or federal law.

title: An Act Concerning Various Revisions Related To Election Processes.
description: To (1) provide a mechanism for determining early voting locations when registrars of voters are unable to agree thereon, (2) modify the deadlines by which registrars of voters certify information regarding early voting and same-day election registration locations to the Secretary of the State and allow amendments to such certifications with notice to the Secretary, (3) eliminate the use of envelopes for early voting ballots and allow such ballots to be deposited directly into voting tabulators after being marked, (4) require registrars of voters to submit to the Secretary information regarding early voting and same-day election registration moderators, (5) prohibit early voting and same-day election registration officials from engaging in certain partisan activities on days for which they are appointed to serve, (6) align the provisions for appointment of same-day election registration officials with those for appointment of early voting officials, (7) amend a provision regarding the attachment of party enrollment privileges for consistency with prior changes, (8) prohibit registrars of voters from appointing as moderators certain persons with criminal backgrounds, (9) expand certain post-election procedures for the correction of returns to all towns rather than just those divided into voting districts, (10) provide for notice to the Secretary in certain matters relating to state or federal voting rights, (11) allow for the correction of errors or omissions of timely filed endorsement, nominating or other candidacy-related certificates that would operate to invalidate such certificates if not corrected, (12) provide for the Secretary's preapproval of town's ballots and authority to order corrections in case of omissions or errors, (13) during the ninety days prior to an election or primary, allow the Secretary to go to Superior Court to seek a declaratory judgment on behalf of electors alleging aggrievement, (14) require absentee ballot counters to maintain a log of rejected absentee ballots, (15) for discrepancy recanvasses, (A) require that all districts in a municipality be examined and not just the district in which the discrepancy was found, and (B) allow one party representative to communicate directly with the moderator, (16) exempt from disclosure under the Freedom of Information Act all ballots cast at elections, primaries and referenda, and (17) for voter registration information, (A) limit disclosure of birth date information to just the year, and (B) limit use of such information to election-related, scholarly, journalistic, political or governmental purposes.

title: An Act Concerning Prescription Drugs And Over-the-counter Diet Pills And Supplements.
description: To prohibit marketing of certain weight loss pills and supplements to minors and enact legal and privacy protections for prescribers of prescription drugs for reproductive and gender-affirming health care.

title: An Act Concerning Liquor Permits And Tobacco Bars.
description: To authorize the Department of Consumer Protection to issue a cafe liquor permit to additional tobacco bars.

title: An Act Concerning Legislative Proposals Of The Connecticut Lottery Corporation.
description: To enhance lottery operations and fiscal benefits to the state.

title: An Act Concerning The Department Of Consumer Protection's Recommendations Regarding Liquor Control.
description: To (1) eliminate a requirement that certain out-of-state shipper permittees report to the Department of Consumer Protection records concerning sales and shipments to consumers in this state, (2) define "retailer" for purposes of certain out-of-state shippers' permits concerning wine, (3) specify that applicants for issuance or renewal of a liquor permit that allows on-premises serving or consumption of alcoholic liquor must disclose to the department a detailed description of the type of live entertainment to be provided, (4) specify that the department shall refuse any liquor permit to a minor as the permittee or as a member, principal or partner of the backer, unless such permit is for a trust with a named beneficiary who is a minor, (5) alter the evidentiary burden applicable to a permittee who is charged with serving or furnishing an alcoholic beverage to a minor, and (6) make various technical and conforming changes to the statutes concerning liquor control.

title: An Act Concerning The Department Of Consumer Protection's Recommendations Regarding Cannabis Regulation And Electronic Nicotine Delivery System Dealer Registration.
description: To (1) require cannabis establishments to submit marijuana and cannabis samples to cannabis testing laboratories for purposes of testing conducted in accordance with laboratory testing standards established by the Commissioner of Consumer Protection, (2) provide that the commissioner shall not issue or renew an electronic nicotine delivery system certificate of dealer registration to an applicant if the commissioner finds that the applicant, or the owner, authorized owner or named designee of the applicant, has failed to satisfy various requirements or is the subject of an adverse administrative decision or delinquency assessment from the Department of Revenue Services, (3) specify who may deliver cannabis, (4) modify existing requirements concerning the availability of a pharmacist at a hybrid retailer establishment and apply such modified requirements to dispensary facilities, and (5) make various minor, technical and conforming changes to statutes concerning cannabis regulation.

title: An Act Concerning Streaming Video Services And The Volume Of Commercial Advertisements.
description: To (1) provide that no streaming video service shall transmit the audio of any commercial advertisement at a volume that is louder than the volume established by the Federal Communications Commission for television broadcast stations or multichannel video programming distributors, and (2) authorize the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to issue a time-limited waiver from the volume limitation in the event of a significant financial hardship.

title: An Act Concerning Solar Contractors And Consumer Protections Regarding Solar Energy.
description: To (1) exempt from licensing requirements certain persons (A) employed by, and under the direction of, a licensed solar contractor, and (B) performing certain work on a solar photovoltaic facility, (2) amend the Home Solicitation Sales Act by (A) defining and redefining various terms, (B) requiring the Office of Consumer Counsel to develop a consumer handbook concerning home solicitation sales of residential solar photovoltaic systems, (C) requiring sellers to make additional disclosures, (D) establishing requirements concerning sellers of residential solar photovoltaic systems, and (E) modifying the penalty applicable for violations of said act, and (3) require residential solar lenders and lessors to provide payoff statements and transfer documentation.

title: An Act Permitting Sixteen And Seventeen-year-old Drivers To Transport Siblings.
description: To permit a person who is sixteen or seventeen years of age to transport such person's siblings after being issued a motor vehicle operator's license.

title: An Act Concerning Driver Education And Student Safety.
description: To (1) permit a student to choose the gender of such student's driving instructor prior to behind-the-wheel instruction, (2) require vehicles used by a drivers' school to be equipped with an electronic monitoring system and an audio or video monitoring system, and (3) provide behind-the-wheel instruction in how to respond to a traffic stop by a law enforcement officer.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Connecticut Airport Authority Regarding The Licensure And Registration Of Airports And Other Air Navigation Facilities.
description: To implement the recommendations of the Connecticut Airport Authority regarding the licensure and registration of airports and other air navigation facilities.

title: An Act Concerning Public Transportation.
description: To (1) restore service on Shore Line East, (2) implement certain public transportation projects and initiatives, (3) require the Department of Transportation to provide notice of proposed fare increases, instead of any fare change, for mass transportation by land, and (4) establish programs for the purchase of bus passes for distribution to high school students and veterans.

title: An Act Concerning Emergency Medical Services Response Time Transparency.
description: To require the Commissioner of Public Health to establish an emergency medical services response time dashboard to collect and display emergency medical services response time data.

title: An Act Concerning Nutrition And Food-based Interventions For Patients With Diabetes And Congestive Heart Failure.
description: To require hospitals to (1) examine the nutrition needs of community members with diabetes and congestive heart failure when conducting a community health needs assessment, and (2) prioritize medically tailored and food-based interventions for such community members in the hospital's community benefits implementation strategy.

title: An Act Concerning Internet Gaming Disorder.
description: To require the Commissioner of Mental Health and Addiction Services to develop a comprehensive public health plan to identify, prevent and reduce the risks associated with Internet gaming disorder and identify any link between Internet gaming and gambling behaviors.

title: An Act Concerning The Waterbury Land Bank.
description: To provide funding for the Waterbury Land Bank Authority to acquire, maintain, remediate or develop real property and for related projects in the city of Waterbury.

title: An Act Requiring A Study Of The Feasibility Of Reducing The Time To Switch Electric Suppliers.
description: To require the Consumer Counsel to conduct a study of the feasibility of reducing the time it takes a consumer to switch electric suppliers.

title: An Act Requiring A Study Of The Design Of Residential Electric Customer Bills.
description: To require the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to conduct a study concerning the depiction of the public benefits charge on residential electric customer bills.

title: An Act Requiring A Study Of The Renewable Energy Certificate Market.
description: To require the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to conduct a study on the efficacy of the market for certificates issued by the New England Power Pool Generation Information System.

title: An Act Eliminating Certain Tax Incentives For Data Centers.
description: To eliminate certain tax incentives for data centers in the state.

title: An Act Requiring A Study Of Natural Gas Rates For Commercial And Agricultural Customers.
description: To require the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to conduct a study of rates for commercial and agricultural natural gas customers who have intermittent peak monthly demand.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Auditors Of Public Accounts.
description: To implement the recommendations of the Auditors of Public Accounts submitted in their most recent annual report, including to require Governor or Attorney General approval for additional agreements with state employees over a certain amount, require agreements with foundations to provide when foundations will reimburse the expenses, salaries and benefits of state employees providing services for the foundation, remove the Comptroller from the Treasurer's audit, remove the State Contracting Standard Board's ability to request the auditors to conduct its audits, modify provisions concerning state agency contracts and agreements for auditing services, add a time frame for quasi-public agency annual reports to the auditors and provide that the annual comprehensive financial review of the Technical Services Revolving Fund is performed as part of the audit of the State Comptroller's annual comprehensive financial report.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of Reestablishing The Duties, Responsibilities And Staffing Of The Legislative Program Review And Investigations Committee.
description: To require the Office of Legislative Management to conduct a study of reestablishing the duties, responsibilities and staffing of the Legislative Program Review and Investigations Committee within the Government Oversight Committee.

title: An Act Concerning Pension Revocation Or Reduction For Public Officials And State Or Municipal Employees Convicted Of Crimes Related To State Or Municipal Office.
description: To establish a rebuttable presumption of pension revocation for public officials and pension reduction for state or municipal employees when such official or employee commits a crime related to state or municipal office and to modify what factors the court can consider when determining whether to reduce or revoke the pension of such official or employee.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of State Agency Response Times To Freedom Of Information Act Requests.
description: To require the Office of Policy and Management to conduct a study of state agency response times to Freedom of Information Act requests.

title: An Act Increasing The Authority Of The Auditors Of Public Accounts.
description: To authorize the Auditors of Public Accounts to (1) require additional review in audits where only a sampling of transactions was obtained, (2) require physical site visits of certain housing and human services providers, (3) establish agency and quasi-public agency performance and accountability standards, and (4) issue subpoenas pursuant to an investigation.

title: An Act Concerning Additional Processes For The Review Of Existing Agency Regulations For Possible Amendment Or Repeal.
description: To establish a Regulation Sunset Commission to make recommendations for the elimination of agency regulations and to establish an online portal for public input concerning potential amendments or the repeal of agency regulations.

title: An Act Repealing Security Deposit Maximums.
description: To repeal the current statutory maximum of one or two months' rent a landlord can require a tenant to pay as a security deposit.

title: An Act Concerning Tax Credits For The Conversion Of Commercial Properties.
description: To establish tax credits for the conversion of commercial properties into housing.

title: An Act Concerning The Certification Of Independent Inspectors And Inspection Firms To Perform State Building Code Inspections.
description: To establish a program to certify independent inspectors and inspection firms to perform inspections under the State Building Code.

title: An Act Concerning The Purchase Of Residential Property By Private Equity Entities.
description: To require a seventy-five-day waiting period for private equity entities to offer to purchase one or two-family homes.

title: An Act Concerning Evictions For Cause.
description: To require cause for the eviction of certain tenants and residents of mobile manufactured home parks.

title: An Act Concerning Property And Casualty Insurance.
description: To require that the Insurance Department conduct a study concerning issues related to property and casualty insurance in the state.

title: An Act Concerning Female Genital Mutilation.
description: To (1) establish the crime of female genital mutilation, (2) allow for testimony outside of the courtroom for victims twelve years of age or younger, (3) prohibit a witness who is a victim of female genital mutilation from being automatically adjudged incompetent due to age, (4) authorize a civil action by a victim, (5) abrogate immunity between a parent and child if the action is brought by the child against the parent, and (6) allow such actions within thirty years from the victim attaining the age of eighteen years.

title: An Act Concerning Roaming Dogs.
description: To enhance penalties for unlawfully permitting a dog to roam at large.

title: An Act Concerning Transfer Of A Motor Vehicle Registration Upon The Death Of The Owner Of The Vehicle.
description: To facilitate transfer of a motor vehicle registration to a beneficiary upon the death of the owner of the vehicle.

title: An Act Concerning The Fees Charged By A Notary For The Performance Of A Notarial Act.
description: To increase the amount of the fee that a notary may charge for the performance of a notarial act from five dollars to ten dollars.

title: An Act Concerning Water Safety And Swim Instruction.
description: To require the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection to establish and administer an annual program to provide free-of-charge swimming lessons to certain children.

title: An Act Concerning Children's Well-being.
description: To require the Commissioner of Children and Families to conduct a study to determine whether policy and procedural changes within the Department of Children and Families may improve the well-being of children.

title: An Act Concerning Additional Funding For The Care 4 Kids Program And Certain Child Care Providers.
description: To increase funding to the Care 4 Kids program to assist families in getting children off of the waiting list and to provide additional supports to child care providers in eastern Connecticut.

title: An Act Limiting The Access Of Private Equity To Funds From The Early Childhood Education Endowment.
description: To give priority to funding from the Early Childhood Education Endowment to those child care service providers that are not backed by private equity.

title: An Act Concerning Various Revisions To The Insurance Statutes.
description: To require the Insurance Commissioner to conduct a study concerning various revisions to the insurance statutes.

title: An Act Authorizing The Comptroller To Withhold Payment For Violations Of The Prevailing Wage Statutes.
description: To allow the Comptroller to withhold payment of money to a contractor or subcontractor for a violation of subsection (b) of section 31-53 of the general statutes where a stop work order was issued by the Labor Commissioner.

title: An Act Concerning Workers' Rights.
description: To require the Labor Commissioner to conduct a study of the rights of employees in the state.

title: An Act Concerning The Labor Department.
description: To require the Labor Commissioner to conduct a study of the Labor Department.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Labor Department.
description: To (1) create a uniform definition of "health care provider" in the unemployment statutes, (2) authorize the Labor Commissioner to make or entertain an offer of compromise for or abate any payments in lieu of contributions due by a reimbursing employer under the unemployment chapter, (3) move enforcement authority for section 53-303e of the general statutes to the Labor Department, (4) repeal the Employment Security Advisory Board, (5) remove the requirement that labor organizations annually file a report with the Labor Commissioner, and (6) make other technical and conforming changes.

title: An Act Authorizing Municipalities To Enforce Certain Blight Regulations Without Providing Notice Or An Opportunity To Remediate.
description: To remove certain notice and opportunity to remediate provisions concerning repeat blight violations.

title: An Act Concerning Local Government.
description: To clarify certain responsibilities of the civil service board.

title: An Act Concerning Nonresident Landlord Registration And Increasing Penalties For Repeat Building And Fire Code Violations.
description: To (1) require certain nonresident landlords, project-based housing providers or agents in charge of rental properties to register certain personal identifying information, and (2) increase penalties for repeat violations of building and fire codes.

title: An Act Requiring The Office Of Policy And Management To Establish A Program To Assist Municipalities In Publishing Certain Budget Information.
description: To require the Office of Policy and Management to establish a program to assist municipalities in publishing certain budget information online.

title: An Act Requiring Municipalities To Post Monthly Reports Concerning Revenue And Certain Expenditures.
description: To require that municipalities post monthly reports concerning revenue and expenditure data on the municipality's Internet web site.

title: An Act Implementing The Department Of Administrative Services' Recommendations Regarding Fire Marshal Qualifications, Burn Injury Reports And State Building Code Provisions Relating To Accessibility.
description: To implement various provisions recommended by the Department of Administrative Services regarding fire marshal qualifications, burn injury reports and State Building Code provisions relating to accessibility.

title: An Act Concerning Military Protective Orders To Address Military Interpersonal Violence.
