description: To (1) provide that courts may consider prior or existing military protective orders that are contained in the state's automated registry of protective orders when issuing a civil protective order for victims of domestic violence, sexual assault, sexual violence or stalking, and (2) specify that such registry contains military protective orders that have been entered into the National Crime Information Center computerized index.

title: An Act Exempting Veterans From Payment Of The Passport To The Parks Motor Vehicle Registration Fee.
description: To exempt veterans from payment of the Passport to the Parks motor vehicle registration fee.

title: An Act Concerning The Legislative Commissioners' Recommendations For Minor And Technical Revisions To Statutes Relating To Veterans' And Military Affairs.
description: To make minor and technical revisions to statutes relating to veterans' and military affairs.

title: An Act Establishing A Task Force To Study Means Of Encouraging More Nursing Homes In The State To Contract With The United States Department Of Veterans Affairs.
description: To study ways to encourage more nursing homes in the state to contract with the United States Department of Veterans Affairs for the provision of care to veterans.

title: An Act Appropriating Funds To The Neglected Cemetery Account And Concerning Care And Maintenance Of Wartime Veterans' Graves.
description: To implement the recommendations of the working group established pursuant to special act 23-25 for the upkeep of veterans' graves.

title: An Act Concerning Members Of The Armed Forces, Veterans And The Department Of Motor Vehicles.
description: To (1) increase from sixty days to ninety days the grace period afforded to members of the armed forces, upon their return from service out of state, for the completion of certain motor vehicle-related renewals or testing, and (2) waive the fee for original issuance of a motor vehicle operator's license or identity card in the case of any person whose veteran status is verified by the Department of Veterans Affairs.

title: An Act Concerning Emergency Power Generator Requirements For Certain Multifamily Housing Projects.
description: To require certain privately owned multifamily housing projects to install and maintain one or more emergency power generators.

title: An Act Providing A Family Caregiver Tax Credit.
description: To allow a tax credit for eligible expenditures incurred by a family caregiver for the care and support of an eligible family member.

title: An Act Increasing Financial Assistance For Grandparents And Other Nonparent Relatives Raising Certain Children.
description: To provide the same financial benefits to grandparents and other nonparent relatives who adopt their grandchildren or relative children as those who adopt unrelated children.

title: An Act Requiring Home Health Aide Agencies To Provide Certain Personal Protective Equipment To Home Health Aides.
description: To require home health aide agencies to provide personal protective equipment to home health aide employees.

title: An Act Concerning The Department Of Social Services' Recommendations Regarding Exceptions To The Nursing Home Bed Moratorium, Nursing Home Resident Data And Nursing Home Reimbursement Rate Caps For Related Party Employees.
description: To (1) authorize additional nursing home beds in certain geographic areas of the state under certain conditions, (2) require licensed nursing homes to submit resident data to the Commissioner of Social Services in a timely fashion to ensure proper calculation of reimbursement rates, and (3) authorize the commissioner not to include related parties as employees when considering costs of a nursing home in rate determinations.

title: An Act Concerning Funding Of The Quality Metrics Program For Nursing Homes.
description: To implement the Department of Social Services' quality metrics program for nursing homes.

title: An Act Clarifying The Meanings Of "sexual Intercourse" And "sexual Contact".
description: To clarify the meanings of "sexual intercourse" and "sexual contact".

title: An Act Concerning The Responsibilities And Duties Of The State Marshal Commission, The State Marshals Advisory Board And State Marshals.
description: To: (1) Make revisions to the duties and composition of the State Marshals Commission, (2) make revisions to the duties of the State Marshals Advisory Board, (3) ensure timely and reliable access to state marshals for service of a restraining order or a civil protection order, and (4) revise the fees associated with certain removal actions.

title: An Act Concerning The Definition Of "child Sexual Abuse Material".
description: To expand the definition of "child sexual abuse material".

title: An Act Concerning The Statute Of Limitation For Injury Caused By Fraud In The Provision Of Fertility Care And Treatment.
description: To provide that an action to recover damages for personal injury to a person caused by fraud in the provision of fertility care and treatment may be brought not later than three years from the date the minor child affected by such fraud reaches the age of majority, or three years after the date on which the fraud is discovered, whichever is later.

title: An Act Concerning Trade Names, Fraudulent Filings, Impermissible Business Solicitations, Dissolution Of Corporations, The Issuance Of An Apostille And Fees Charged By A Notary.
description: To: (1) Revise processes related to applications for, and issuance of, trade name certificates, (2) provide the Secretary of the State with additional authority to take actions with respect to fraudulent filings, deceptive business solicitations and the dissolution of corporations that fail to comply with state law, (3) revise provisions relating to the issuance of an apostille, and (4) increase permissible fees that may be charged by a notary.

title: An Act Concerning State Law Protections For Health Care Providers And Patients Related To The Provision Of A Legally Protected Health Care Activity.
description: To extend state law protections for health care providers and patients related to the provision of a legally protected health care activity.

title: An Act Concerning Recommendations From The Department Of Consumer Protection With Respect To The Connecticut Unfair Trade Practices Act And Sports Wagering.
description: To (1) increase the maximum amount of restitution available under the Connecticut Unfair Trade Practices Act, (2) make consistent statutory provisions concerning record retention under said act, and (3) update the state's cheating statute to include provisions relating to sports wagering.

title: An Act Concerning Court Proceedings Involving A Child Or Youth Who Is Alleged To Have Been Uncared For, Neglected Or Abused.
description: To restructure statutory provisions concerning court proceedings involving a child or youth who is alleged to have been uncared for, neglected or abused.

title: An Act Concerning The Reallocation Of Certain State Funds And Various Provisions Relating To Education, Public Safety, General Government, Elections, Intermediate Care Facilities And Warehouse Distribution Centers.
description: An Act Concerning The Reallocation Of Certain State Funds And Various Provisions Relating To Education, Public Safety, General Government, Elections, Intermediate Care Facilities And Warehouse Distribution Centers.

title: An Act Concerning Redemption Of Out-of-state Beverage Containers.
description: An Act Concerning Redemption Of Out-of-state Beverage Containers.

title: An Act Establishing A Debt Collection Exemption Relating To Joint Accounts.
description: To establish an exemption from debt collection for any part of the balance of an account deemed a joint account in which the exemptioner has no equitable interest.

title: An Act Requiring The Department Of Banking To Conduct A Study Relating To Signature Guarantee Programs.
description: To require the Department of Banking to (1) conduct a study to assess (A) the availability of signature guarantee programs at financial institutions in the state, and (B) any issues relating to the ability of consumers to access such programs in order to obtain a guarantee, and (2) submit a report concerning the results of such study to the joint standing committee of the General Assembly having cognizance of matters relating to banking.

title: An Act Revising Various Provisions Relating To Certain Approvals By The Banking Commissioner And Connecticut Bank Branch Applications.
description: To revise various provisions relating to (1) community reinvestment performance evaluation ratings and certain approvals by the Banking Commissioner, and (2) timeframes applicable to certain applications regarding Connecticut bank branches.

title: An Act Concerning Secured Credit Cards.
description: To require each Connecticut bank and Connecticut credit union to make available a secured credit card and account information for the secured credit card.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of Programs Administered By The Department Of Economic And Community Development.
description: To require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to study programs administered by the Department of Economic and Community Development.

title: An Act Concerning Tourism.
description: To establish a working group to study statewide marketing and tourism in the state.

title: An Act Concerning Economic Development And Comprehensive Energy Strategy.
description: To include the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development in the preparation of any Comprehensive Energy Strategy as provided in section 16a-3d of the general statutes.

title: An Act Concerning The Department Of Economic And Community Development's Recommendations For Revisions To The Commerce Statutes.
description: To implement the Department of Economic and Community Development's recommendations for revisions to the commerce statutes, including (1) removing references to certain Department of Economic and Community Development offices, (2) repealing or modifying certain reporting requirements, (3) repealing defunct programs, (4) addressing changes to federal funding, (5) revising the Manufacturing Innovation Fund Advisory Board membership and establishing a board absentee policy, (6) establishing a council absentee policy for the Tourism Council, (7) revising the name, charge and membership of the Minority Business Initiative Advisory Board and permitting the board to establish bylaws, (8) implementing certain revisions to the concentrated poverty statutes, and (9) rename the Small Business Express program and the small business express assistance account.

title: An Act Requiring Boards Of Education To Post Curriculum Online.
description: To require local and regional boards of education to post curriculum on such board's Internet web site.

title: An Act Concerning The Creation Of A Contingency Special Education Grant, A Prohibition On Private Equity In Special Education And The Establishment Of A Working Group To Consider Innovations In The Provision Of Special Education Services.
description: To (1) provide a contingency special education grant for certain unanticipated special education costs, (2) prohibit the Department of Education from approving a private provider of special education services that is owned or operated by a private equity company, and (3) establish a working group to consider innovations in the provision of special education and related services through public-private partnerships.

title: An Act Concerning Vocational Education And Workforce Development.
description: To require a study for expanding vocational education to grades kindergarten to eight, inclusive, and establish a pilot program for training wastewater treatment facility operators.

title: An Act Concerning Disconnected Youth.
description: To require P20 WIN to share data with a nonprofit organization that provides data and data support to other public entities, lower the maximum number of days for an in-school suspension during one school year, allow out-of-school suspension for violent behavior, acts of sexual misconduct or possession of a weapon or controlled substance and require the Department of Education to establish a Disconnected Youth Investment Grant program.

title: An Act Concerning Assorted Revisions To The Education Statutes.
description: To make assorted revisions to the education statutes.

title: An Act Concerning Wakesurfing On Certain Lakes In The State.
description: To authorize wakesurfing on most lakes in the state provided it occurs a certain distance from shore.

title: An Act Concerning The Protection Of Animals Used In Certain Research.
description: To require an examination of the need to establish breeding and other care standards for animals used in medical research in the state.

title: An Act Concerning The Release Of Sterile Carp In Pachaug Pond.
description: To require the release of sterile carp in Pachaug Pond for the control of invasive vegetation.

title: An Act Concerning The Testing Of Soils At Certain Solar Facilities.
description: To require the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection to conduct soil testing on a biennial basis at utility-scale solar arrays in the state.

title: An Act Concerning Resource Recovery Facilities In The State.
description: To enable the Bristol Resource Recovery Facility to not pay certain fees to the Department of Revenue Services for a five-year period.

title: An Act Concerning Animal Welfare.
description: To identify resources for persons needing to place their companion animal in another person's care due to a domestic violence situation and to clarify the authority of the State Veterinarian to combat disease among companion animals and establish a working group to study ways to improve the funding of the animal population control program.

title: An Act Concerning The Use Of Battery-powered Leaf Blowers And Similar Equipment By The State And Municipalities.
description: To transition to battery powered leaf blowers and related equipment throughout the state.

title: An Act Establishing A Working Group Concerning Electric Transmission Facilities And Electric Grid Capacity Planning.
description: To require the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to convene a working group for the purpose of examining and making recommendations regarding the siting and use of electric transmission facilities and electric grid capacity planning in the state.

title: An Act Concerning Requirements For Certain Excavation Projects.
description: To specify that no person shall be required to keep an excavation site open for a period of time after the completion of work unless required as a condition of a permit.

title: An Act Establishing A Task Force To Study Issues Relating To Consumer Protection And Occupational Licensing.
description: To establish a task force to study issues relating to consumer protection and occupational licensing.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Office Of State Ethics For Revisions To The State Codes Of Ethics.
description: To (1) require members of boards, commissions, committees and councils within the Executive Department with contract authority to file statements of financial interests, (2) permit the filing of the name of certain tax-sheltered annuity retirement plans in lieu of naming specific securities within such statements, and (3) apply substantial conflict of interest provisions in the state code of ethics for public officials and state employees to conflicts involving the public official's or state employee's nonstate employer or spouse's nonstate employer.

title: An Act Concerning Government Oversight Over Fraud And Waste And Establishing The Office Of Government Oversight And Efficiency.
description: To establish a working group to uncover fraud and waste in state government, establish the Office of Government Oversight and Efficiency, require state agencies to notify affected parties of material and substantial changes in law, establish the Results-Based Accountability Working Group and require the involvement of additional committees and public officials for audit reports that have financial implications.

title: An Act Prohibiting The Disclosure Of The Residential Address Of Public School Teachers Under The Freedom Of Information Act And Establishing A Task Force Concerning Mass Requests Under The Act.
description: To prohibit disclosure of the residential address of public school teachers under the Freedom of Information Act and to establish a task force to study how to respond to the issue of mass requests created by artificial intelligence.

title: An Act Concerning Husky C Asset Limits.
description: To phase-in the elimination of asset limits in the HUSKY C program.

title: An Act Expanding Emergency Medicaid Coverage.
description: To expand emergency Medicaid coverage to the extent permissible under federal law.

title: An Act Requiring Nursing Homes To Spend Eighty Per Cent Of Revenue On Direct Patient Care.
description: To require nursing homes to spend eighty per cent of revenue on direct patient care.

title: An Act Expanding Medicaid Eligibility For Older Adults With Disabilities.
description: To disregard certain income for older adults with disabilities when determining their eligibility for Medicaid.

title: An Act Compensating Spouses For State-funded Home Care.
description: To authorize payment to spouses and others who provide care under the state-funded portion of the Connecticut home-care program for the elderly.

title: An Act Concerning Step Therapy Requirements For Prescription Drugs Covered Under The Medicaid Program.
description: To align step therapy requirements with manufacturer guidelines for prescription drugs covered under the Medicaid program.

title: An Act Concerning Notice To Parties Before A Fair Rent Commission.
description: To require fair rent commissions to notify parties to a hearing of their rights under the hearing and the scope of the commission's lawful authority.

title: An Act Defining Advance Rental Payments.
description: To differentiate advance rental payments and security deposits and permit the use of advance rental payments.

title: An Act Concerning The Composition Of Fair Rent Commissions.
description: To require that fair rent commissions consist of an equal number of landlords and residential tenants.

title: An Act Concerning Utility Charges For Residential Dwelling Units.
description: To require that a tenant only be charged for utilities if such tenant's dwelling unit has an individual meter.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of Housing Policy.
description: To study the housing policies of the state.

title: An Act Establishing A Task Force Concerning The Removal And Storage Of Property Of Evicted Tenants.
description: To require that personal property left behind after eviction be stored for fifteen days by the plaintiff and to permit the plaintiff to dispose of such property as such plaintiff sees fit following the expiration of fifteen days.

title: An Act Concerning Housing Unit-equivalent Points For Developments Subject To Litigation.
description: To prevent the receipt of housing unit-equivalent points for certain units located in developments subject to the affordable housing appeals process for a period of more than six months.

title: An Act Allowing Long-term Rental Of Bedrooms In A Single-family Home As Of Right.
description: To allow rental of bedrooms in a single-family home as of right.

title: An Act Concerning Continuing Real Estate Education Requirements, Public Marketing Of Certain Real Estate Listings And Revising The Title Of A Real Estate Salesperson To A Real Estate Agent.
description: To: (1) Revise the continuing education requirements for real estate licensees, (2) change the term real estate salesperson to real estate agent, and (3) establish a process regarding the public marketing of certain real estate listings.

title: An Act Concerning Return Of Health Care Provider Payments.
description: To shorten the time period that health carriers may cancel, deny or demand the return of payment from health care providers and to require that health carriers establish an electronic appeal process.

title: An Act Concerning Health Coverage.
description: To: (1) require certain health insurers, preferred provider networks and other entities to include certain provisions in contracts with health care providers regarding reimbursement for certain covered health benefits, (2) clarify the definition of "anti-steering clause" under section 38a-477i of the general statutes, (3) require the Insurance Commissioner to conduct a study concerning various revisions to the insurance statutes, (4) change the time period that a health carrier and participating provider shall continue to abide by the terms of a contract under section 38a-472f of the general statutes, (5) prohibit a health carrier from using a software tool to downcode or deny certain health insurance claims, (6) establish a rebuttable presumption for purposes of the review of an adverse determination under section 38a-591e of the general statutes, and (7) prohibit certain health carriers from requiring step therapy for prescription drugs used to treat a chronic, disabling or life-threatening condition.

title: An Act Concerning Fees Charged For Criminal History Records Checks.
description: To waive certain fees for criminal history records checks in the case of a person seeking a pardon.

title: An Act Protecting Children's Safety By Requiring Affirmative Consent By A Parent Or Guardian For The Use Of A Child's Likeness On Social Media.
description: To prohibit the use of a child's likeness for purposes of marketing or advertising on social media without the affirmative consent of a parent or guardian.

title: An Act Concerning Breastfeeding In The Workplace, Pre And Post-shift Hours And Establishing A Task Force To Study Workplace Heat Safety Standards.
description: To (1) align state and federal law regarding break times for the purpose of breastfeeding or expressing milk during the work day, (2) include security screenings required by an employer in the definition of "hours worked" for purposes of chapter 558 of the general statutes, and (3) establish a task force to study and provide recommendations for the establishment of heat safety standards in the workplace.

title: An Act Concerning The Modifications To The Governor's Workforce Council.
description: To (1) amend the membership of the Governor's Workforce Council in order to comply with federal law, and (2) make other technical and conforming changes.

title: An Act Increasing The Threshold Amount For Felony Unemployment Compensation Fraud.
description: To increase the threshold dollar amount for an individual to become guilty of a felony for receiving unemployment benefits by fraudulent means.

title: An Act Concerning Portal-to-portal Workers' Compensation Coverage For Public Works Department Employees.
description: To provide portal-to-portal workers' compensation coverage for employees of a public works department.

title: An Act Concerning Modifications To The Firefighters Cancer Relief Fund.
description: To amend the reporting requirements of the Treasurer for the Firefighters Cancer Relief Fund.

title: An Act Increasing The Per Diem Rate For Members Of The State Board Of Labor Relations And Compensation For Members Of The Board Of Mediation And Arbitration.
description: To increase (1) the per diem rate for regular and alternative members of the State Board of Labor Relations, and (2) the compensation the State Board of Mediation and Arbitration members receive for their services.

title: An Act Establishing A Just Cause Standard For Teacher Termination Decisions And Requiring Termination Hearings To Be Before A Neutral Arbitrator.
description: To (1) establish a just cause standard for teacher termination decisions, (2) require teacher termination hearings be before a neutral arbitrator, and (3) make the decisions of such neutral arbitrator binding.

title: An Act Concerning The Minimum Fair Wage And Persons Employed At Cannabis Establishments.
description: To clarify that persons employed at cannabis establishments are to be paid the minimum fair wage.

title: An Act Concerning Reasonable Accommodations In The Workplace For Conditions Related To Menopause.
description: To (1) require employers to provide reasonable accommodations in the workplace for conditions related to menopause, (2) require the Commission on Human Rights and Opportunities to develop a model workplace policy regarding reasonable accommodations for conditions related to menopause, and (3) require the Commission on Human Rights and Opportunities to develop education materials regarding conditions related to menopause.

title: An Act Concerning Staffing In The Unemployment Insurance Division In The Labor Department.
description: To increase the number of staff at the Unemployment Insurance Benefits Division in the Labor Department.

title: An Act Concerning Limitations On The Use Of Nondisclosure Agreements.
description: To prohibit the use of nondisclosure agreements in certain instances in the workplace.

title: An Act Concerning Electronic Filing Of Certified Payroll And Daily Logs For Certain Public Works Projects.
description: To (1) require employers working on certain public works projects to submit certified payroll records electronically to the Labor Commissioner and maintain and submit daily logs for workers on site, and (2) require the Labor Commissioner to establish an online system for submission of such certified payroll records and maintain a database of such records.

title: An Act Concerning Unemployment Dependency Allowance.
description: To increase the amount an individual, who is eligible to receive benefits for unemployment, receives in dependency allowance.

title: An Act Concerning The Retention Of Service Contract Workers.
description: To offer greater protections to certain service workers who are displaced or terminated when service contracts are terminated.

title: An Act Authorizing The Deferral Of A Property Revaluation.
description: To allow the city of Hartford to delay the revaluation of real property in the city by one year.

title: An Act Concerning Municipal Issues.
description: To make technical changes to provisions concerning interlocal agreements between municipalities.

title: An Act Concerning Fees In Lieu Of Sidewalk Requirements.
description: To allow municipalities to collect fees in lieu of imposing sidewalk requirements on new developments under certain conditions.

title: An Act Concerning Revisions To Statutes Relating To Municipal Property Tax Assessment.
description: To make various revisions to statutes concerning municipal property tax assessment.

title: An Act Allowing Municipalities To Impose Commercial Vacancy Assessments In Certain Districts.
description: To allow municipalities to impose a commercial vacancy assessment on vacant commercial property located in districts designated by the municipality.

title: An Act Concerning Extreme Weather Protocols.
description: To require the Division of Emergency Management and Homeland Security within the Department of Emergency Services and Public Protection to develop standardized extreme hot and cold weather protocols.

title: An Act Establishing A Bridge Program For Emergency Treatment And Recovery Navigation For Persons With An Opioid Use Disorder.
description: To require hospitals to (1) treat patients presenting to the emergency department with symptoms of opioid use disorder with buprenorphine without requiring admission of the patient to the hospital, (2) discharge such patients from the emergency department with a supply of opioid antagonists, and (3) refer such patients to local substance use disorder treatment programs.

title: An Act Concerning The Uniform Investigation Of Accident Report And Certain Reports By Peace Officers.
description: To require (1) a motor vehicle accident report to be made available not later than thirty days after the completion of the related investigation, and (2) a peace officer to prepare and provide, upon request, a report describing any matter in which a person experiences an emergency medical condition or is medically unstable while in direct audio or visual contact with, or under the custody or control of, the peace officer.

title: An Act Establishing A Working Group To Study Roadside Safety Concerns Associated With Wreckers And Towing And Recovery Professionals.
description: To establish a working group to study roadside safety concerns associated with wreckers and towing and recovery professionals.

title: An Act Concerning A State Explosives, Blasting And Pyrotechnic Code.
description: To require the adoption of a State Explosives, Blasting and Pyrotechnic Code and to establish the procedure for such adoption.

title: An Act Establishing Various Requirements Regarding Elevators.
description: To establish various requirements applicable to owners of residential elevator buildings.

title: An Act Concerning The Hourly Compensation For Adjunct Fire Instructors.
description: To require the hourly compensation for adjunct fire instructors to be adjusted at the same percentage rate as any general wage increase and cost-of-living adjustment included within the most recently ratified agreement between the state and the State Employees Bargaining Agent Coalition.

title: An Act Establishing A Personal Flotation Device Requirement For Children Under The Age Of Twelve While On Public Docks, Wharves And Piers.
description: To require children under the age of twelve to wear personal flotation devices while on any dock, wharf or pier.

title: An Act Concerning Connecticut Wing Civil Air Patrol Youth Camps.
description: To provide that the Connecticut Wing Civil Air Patrol within the Department of Emergency Services and Public Protection may establish, conduct or maintain a youth camp without a license.

title: An Act Allowing A Personal Income Tax Deduction For Stipends Paid To Volunteer Firefighters, Volunteer Fire Police Officers And Volunteer Ambulance Members.
description: To allow a personal income tax deduction for a stipend paid by a municipality to a volunteer firefighter, volunteer fire police officer or volunteer ambulance member.

title: An Act Concerning The Expansion Of The Crisis Initiative Pilot Program Throughout The State.
description: To require the Division of State Police to expand the CRISIS Initiative pilot program throughout the state.

title: An Act Concerning School Mapping Data Services.
description: To establish a school mapping data grant program.

title: An Act Concerning Warnings And Other Measures On The Department Of Veterans Affairs Internet Web Site For The Protection Of Veterans Against Certain Providers Of Assistance With Veterans' Benefits Claims.
description: To require the posting of warnings and other measures on the Department of Veterans Affairs' Internet web site to protect veterans against certain providers of assistance with veterans' benefits claims.

title: An Act Establishing A Personal Income Tax Deduction For Military Funeral Honor Guard Detail Compensation.
description: To establish a personal income tax deduction for compensation received as a result of participation in military funeral honor guard details.

title: An Act Concerning Certain Property Tax Exemptions For Disabled Veterans.
description: To address various concerns related to certain property tax exemptions for disabled veterans, such as applicability, filing deadlines and abatement or refund.

title: An Act Concerning Workforce Development In The State.
description: To study workforce development in the state.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Task Force To Support Promise Programs In The State.
description: To implement the recommendations of the task force to support promise programs in the state.

title: An Act Requiring Programs Concerning Problem Gambling At Public Institutions Of Higher Education.
description: To require an on-campus program concerning problem gambling at public institutions of higher education.

title: An Act Concerning Edible Food Recovery.
description: To require the development of protocols regarding the donation of surplus edible food by retail food establishments to food distribution organizations.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Office Of Workforce Strategy Related To Higher Education.
description: To implement the recommendations of the Office of Workforce Strategy.

title: An Act Redefining "executive Branch Agency" For Purposes Of Data Governance.
description: To redefine "executive branch agency" for purposes of data management standards.

title: An Act Concerning The Titling Of Proposed Bills.
description: To require the use of a generic title for a proposed bill when the legislative proponent and legislative commissioners are not in agreement concerning its title.

title: An Act Concerning The Use Of Ranked-choice Voting In Party Caucuses, Conventions And Primaries, Including Presidential Preference Primaries, And In Certain Municipal Elections.
description: To afford political parties the flexibility to use ranked-choice voting in party caucuses, conventions and primaries, including presidential preference primaries.

title: An Act Concerning Election Administration Oversight.
description: To establish a Municipal Election Accountability Board to exercise oversight of municipalities in the administration of their elections, primaries and referenda.

title: An Act Concerning The Mashantucket Pequot And Mohegan Fund.
description: To restore the Mashantucket Pequot and Mohegan Fund to its original intent of funding all towns.

title: An Act Concerning Youth Employment And Training Funds.
description: To update the allocation of the Connecticut Youth Employment Program funds.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of Microtransit.
description: To require the Commissioner of Transportation to conduct a study of microtransit.

title: An Act Concerning The Availability Of Breast Cancer Screening, Diagnosis And Treatment Services For Women Committed To The Custody Of The Department Of Correction.
description: To provide additional breast cancer screening, diagnosis and treatment options to women committed to the custody of the Department of Correction.

title: An Act Concerning Rules Of Minor Political Parties.
description: To provide that minor political parties are required, and not merely allowed, to abide by their party rules in making nominations for public office and selecting town committee members or convention delegates.

title: An Act Concerning Special Elections To Fill Vacancies Due To The Death Of An Elected Official.
description: To provide that whenever a vacancy occurs in an elective office due to the death of the person holding such office, the Governor shall wait at least seven days before issuing writs of election to fill such vacancy at a special election.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Risk-limiting Audits Working Group.
description: To implement the recommendations of the risk-limiting audits working group.

title: An Act Studying Efforts To Increase Voter Participation And Authorizing Municipal Pilot Programs To Promote Such Efforts.
description: To (1) establish a task force to study increasing voter participation, and civic engagement generally, in this state, and (2) allow municipalities to establish pilot programs to promote the goal of achieving one hundred per cent voter participation.

title: An Act Permitting Ninety-credit Degree Programs At Institutions Of Higher Education In The State.
description: To permit ninety-credit degree programs at institutions of higher education.

title: An Act Concerning Democracy And Government Accountability.
description: To enact statutory provisions providing for the accountable administration and enforcement of law in the state.

title: An Act Concerning The Board Of Pardons And Paroles.
description: To eliminate the statutorily prescribed amount for payment to part-time board members.

title: An Act Permitting Separate Areas For Exercise On The Basis Of Sex In Health Clubs And Gyms And Concerning The Disposition Of Cases Before The Commission On Human Rights And Opportunities.
description: To (1) permit health clubs and gyms to offer separate areas for exercise on the basis of sex, and (2) make statutory changes to commission processes involving requests for early legal intervention, the reopening of previously closed complaints and time parameters for pursuing a complaint in court.

title: An Act Concerning Probate Court Operations.
description: To make various changes concerning Probate Court administrative processes, court procedures and the training of Probate Court judges and to repeal provisions relating to the establishment of a working group.

title: An Act Concerning A Bridge Program To Allow Access To Food, Housing And Health Care Benefits.
description: To establish a plan for a state-funded bridge program for persons at risk of losing federal food, health care and housing assistance.

title: An Act Revising The Definition Of "retired Police Officer" For Purposes Of Certain Provisions Regarding School Security Services.
description: To revise the definition of "retired police officer" for the purposes of certain provisions regarding school security services.

title: An Act Concerning Cybersecurity.
description: To establish various cybersecurity provisions relating to (1) a cybersecurity framework, (2) a prohibition on penalizing cybersecurity employees for certain reports, (3) notifications regarding cybersecurity incidents, (4) minimum safeguards, (5) quantum-transition readiness requirements, (6) the "Connecticut Cybersecurity Seed Fund" grant program, (7) a "bug bounty" program, (8) the dissemination of cybersecurity intelligence, (9) the State Cybersecurity Intelligence Task Force, and (10) the state's operational response to cybersecurity emergencies.

title: An Act Requiring A Study Of Statutes And Regulations Relating To Fireworks.
description: To require the Commissioner of Emergency Services and Public Protection to conduct a study of the general statutes and regulations of Connecticut state agencies relating to fireworks to determine whether any revisions to such statutes or regulations are necessary and to submit a report concerning the results of such study.

title: An Act Concerning The Impaired Driving Enforcement And Drug Recognition Training Grant Program.
description: To establish the impaired driving enforcement and drug recognition training grant program and require that a certain portion of a cannabis-related tax be expended for the purposes of providing grants pursuant to said program.

title: An Act Concerning The Display Of Lighted Lamps On Bicycles, Electric Bicycles And Electric Scooters.
description: To require each bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter operated upon the public highway to display a lighted lamp upon the forward part of such bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter during certain times.

title: An Act Authorizing The Commissioner Of Motor Vehicles To Issue Permits Allowing Organ Transport Vehicles To Use Certain Lights.
description: To authorize the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles to issue permits allowing organ transport vehicles to use certain lights.

title: An Act Concerning Liquor Permits, Fire Safety And Prevention Inspections, The Registration Of Certain Information And Various Requirements Relating To Juice Bars.
description: To (1) delete a provision regarding certain inspections not being deemed to constitute a precondition to renewal of a liquor permit, (2) modify certain requirements relating to fire safety and prevention inspections, (3) require certain nonresident owners, project-based housing providers or agents in charge to register certain information, and (4) establish various requirements relating to juice bars.

title: An Act Establishing A Working Group To Study The Statutory Roles Of The Various Law Enforcement And Public Safety Positions In The State.
description: To establish a working group to study the statutory roles of the various law enforcement and public safety positions in the state.

title: An Act Concerning Firefighter Cancer.
description: To (1) make various revisions relating to the Fallen Hero Fund, firefighter cancer death benefits, survivor health insurance coverage and associated payments and reimbursements, and (2) establish a pilot program to reimburse firefighters who receive screening for cancers common to firefighters.

title: An Act Concerning State Police Assigned To Highway Construction Projects.
description: To establish that for any sworn member of the Division of State Police within the Department of Emergency Services and Public Protection assigned to a highway construction project administered by the Department of Transportation, such sworn member shall be paid at a rate established pursuant to an agreement executed between the Commissioner of Emergency Services and Public Protection and the Commissioner of Transportation.

title: An Act Concerning The Offering Price Of A Motor Vehicle And Provisions Of The Franchise Act Governing Agreements Between Automobile Manufacturers Or Distributors And Automobile Dealers.
description: To (1) require a car dealer to include any dealer conveyance fee in the stated price of a motor vehicle in advertisement and in communications with a prospective buyer, and (2) make changes to the Franchise Act as it applies to car manufacturers, distributors and dealers.

title: An Act Revising Various Motor Vehicle Statutes.
description: To revise various motor vehicle statutes regarding removable windshield placards, firefighter driving reciprocity, motor vehicle registration upon the death of the owner of the vehicle, the definition of electric scooter, car rental classifications, electric issuance licensees, the local bridge program and electric bicycles.

title: An Act Concerning Vegetation Management Guidelines By The Department Of Transportation.
description: To require the Commissioner of Transportation to consider the carbon sequestration by trees and other vegetation along highways and determine if revisions to the guidelines governing tree and vegetation management by the Department of Transportation are necessary.

title: An Act Concerning Transportation Network Companies And Rider Safety.
description: To require a transportation network company to (1) annually conduct criminal history records checks of transportation network company drivers, (2) provide annual sexual misconduct prevention and driver education training, and (3) implement certain safety features through its digital network to ensure the safety of riders.

title: An Act Concerning Transportation System Modernization.
description: To revise various transportation-related statutes concerning (1) the type of vehicles eligible for a rebate or voucher under the Connecticut Hydrogen and Electric Automobile Purchase Rebate program, (2) the matching grant program for modernizing existing traffic signal equipment and operations, (3) the requirements for zero-emission school buses and alternative fuel school buses and the related grant program for the purchasing or leasing of zero-emission school buses, (4) a working group to study incentives to increase the use of freight rail transportation in the state, and (5) a working group to study incentives to transport municipal solid waste by freight rail.

title: An Act Requiring The Department Of Economic And Community Development To Develop A Plan To Establish An Artificial Intelligence Small Business Program.
description: To require the Department of Economic and Community Development to develop a plan to establish an artificial intelligence small business program.

title: An Act Concerning Streamlining Certain Department Of Energy And Environmental Protection Permitting Processes.
description: To require the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to (1) develop a framework for allowing third-party qualified professionals to conduct permit review and make permit decision recommendations to the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection, and (2) conduct a review of all permits that are within the commissioner's jurisdiction.

title: An Act Concerning Suppliers Of Electricity.
description: To amend a statute concerning electricity suppliers.

title: An Act Concerning Natural Gas And Gas Companies.
description: To amend a statute concerning gas companies.

title: An Act Concerning Reporting Of Double Utility Poles.
description: To require the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to implement a system for reporting double utility poles.

title: An Act Concerning Biomass Facilities.
description: To redefine "class I renewable energy source" to exclude biomass facilities.

title: An Act Concerning Oversight Over Higher Education.
description: To require the Board of Regents for Higher Education to include additional data and information in its annual report concerning the consolidation of the regional community-technical colleges into the Connecticut State Community College and to require that a copy and any updates to the higher education strategic plan be provided to the legislative committee with cognizance of government oversight.

title: An Act Concerning Oversight Of Plans Pursuant To Section 504 Of The Rehabilitation Act Of 1973 And Special Education Needs In The State.
description: To require various reports and assessments of the needs of students with plans pursuant to Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, give the Office of the Educational Ombudsperson oversight over alleged discriminatory practices related to special education services, require the Department of Education to modify its special education data system for such plans, require the Department of Social Services to evaluate school services with potential Medicaid reimbursement and to require the Chief Workforce Officer to develop a strategic assessment plan to increase the capacity of school social workers and school counselors in the state.

title: An Act Requiring Annual State Agency Performance Plans.
description: To require executive branch state agencies to develop and implement annual performance plans.

title: An Act Concerning Government Oversight Of Energy Regulation In The State.
description: To require the Department of Administrative Services to issue a request for proposals for a consultant to study the existing structure of the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority.

title: An Act Concerning Dual Enrollment Programs.
description: To require the Department of Education to appoint a dual enrollment coordinator to track state-wide dual enrollment programs and to provide scholarships to students required to pay tuition costs for dual enrollment programs.

title: An Act Concerning Research Funding At Institutions Of Higher Education In The State.
description: To establish the Academic Research Funding Commission to distribute research funds to faculty at institutions of higher education in the state.

title: An Act Concerning Medicaid Reimbursement For Emergency Medical Transportation.
description: To increase Medicaid reimbursement for ambulance services by amending the out-of-district mileage calculation for such services.

title: An Act Codifying The Americans With Disabilities Act.
description: To incorporate by reference those provisions of the Americans with Disabilities Act not otherwise addressed in state law.

title: An Act Concerning Palliative And Hospice Care In Litchfield County.
description: To study the need for, and authorize a pilot program to address, palliative and hospice care in Litchfield County.

title: An Act Disregarding The Cash Value Of Life Insurance Policies In Eligibility Determinations For Certain Public Assistance Programs.
description: To disregard the cash value of life insurance policies in eligibility determinations for Medicaid, temporary family assistance, the state supplement program and the state-administered general assistance program.

title: An Act Expanding Long-term Care Options.
description: To rebalance the state's long-term care plan to offer more home-based and community living options.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of The Civil Procedure Laws In The State.
description: To establish a working group to study the civil procedure laws in this state.

title: An Act Concerning Automated Decision Systems Protections For Employees.
description: To establish various requirements concerning the use of automated employment-related decision systems and artificial intelligence technologies.

title: An Act Concerning Advanced Notice Of An Employee's Work Schedule By An Employer.
description: To require employers to provide advanced notice to certain employees of such employee's work schedule and work schedule changes and create a cause of action for violations of advanced notice requirements.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of Minors At Least Sixteen Years Of Age In The Workplace.
description: To require the Labor Commissioner to study positions that minors who are sixteen and seventeen years of age are currently prohibited from holding under state and federal law.

title: An Act Regulating Self-checkout Stations In Grocery Stores.
description: To require that grocery stores that offer self-checkout stations (1) have one manual checkout station operating for every two self-checkout stations operating, (2) have at least one employee for every two self-checkout stations monitoring such stations, and (3) do not operate more than eight self-checkout stations at any time.

title: An Act Concerning Electronic Surveillance Devices And Systems And Self-service Kiosks In Employee Lounges.
description: To exempt self-service kiosks from the prohibition on electronic surveillance devices and systems in employee lounges.

title: An Act Concerning Unemployment For Striking Workers.
description: To allow certain striking workers involved in a labor dispute that has been continuous for fourteen days access to unemployment benefits.

title: An Act Requiring A Study Of Labor Law Violations By Limited Liability Companies And Other Business Entities.
description: To require the Labor Commissioner, in consultation with the Secretary of the State, Commissioner of Revenue Services and Commissioner of Administrative Services, to study the potential for members of a limited liability company or other business entity to circumvent certain labor laws by establishing a new business entity.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of Retirement Health Benefits For Paraeducators.
description: To require the Comptroller to study retirement health benefits for paraeducators.

title: An Act Concerning The Provision Of Survivor's Benefits And Health Insurance Coverage To Family Members Of Correction Officers, Court Support Services Division Investigators, Criminal Justice Division Investigators And Office Of The Chief Public Defender Investigators Killed In The Line Of Duty.
description: To provide survivor's benefits and health insurance coverage to the family members of correction officers, Court Support Services Division investigators, Criminal Justice Division investigators and Office of the Chief Public Defender investigators killed in the line of duty.

title: An Act Authorizing Certain Municipal Employees To Serve On Municipal Boards Of Finance.
description: To authorize municipal employees to serve on municipal boards of finance if such employees receive less than ten thousand dollars in salary or wages annually.

title: An Act Concerning The Advisory Commission On Intergovernmental Relations.
description: To require the Advisory Commission on Intergovernmental Relations to maintain certain information and recommendations concerning state mandates on the commission's Internet web site.

title: An Act Requiring The Office Of Policy And Management To Conduct A Study Concerning The Feasibility Of Authorizing Municipalities That Have Entered Into Revenue Sharing Agreements To Adopt Differential Mill Rates.
description: To require the Office of Policy and Management to conduct a study concerning the feasibility of authorizing municipalities that have entered into revenue sharing agreements to adopt differential mill rates.

title: An Act Establishing A Homestead Property Tax Exemption.
description: To establish a property tax exemption of fifty thousand dollars of the assessed value of owner-occupied single-family dwellings.

title: An Act Amending The Charter Of The Metropolitan District Of Hartford County.
description: To make various amendments to the charter of The Metropolitan District of Hartford County.

title: An Act Concerning The Recommendations Of The Intergovernmental Policy And Planning Division Within The Office Of Policy And Management.
description: To (1) make revisions to statutes relating to the (A) local capital improvement fund, (B) small town economic assistance program, and (C) public school district repair and improvement project program, (2) classify certain property owned or held in trust by the state as farm land, forest land, open space land or maritime heritage land, and (3) repeal statutes (A) relating to the intertown capital equipment purchase incentive program, and (B) prohibiting zoning regulations from treating family child care homes and group child care homes located in a residence in a manner different from single or multifamily dwellings.

title: An Act Concerning The Standard Of Care For Immunization.
description: To clarify the standard of care for immunization in the state.

title: An Act Establishing An Advisory Council On Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-cell Therapy And Other Gene Therapies.
description: To establish an advisory council on access to chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy and other gene therapies for the treatment of cancer.

title: An Act Concerning The Release Of Lighter-than-air Balloons.
description: To prohibit the sale of helium for purposes of filling lighter-than-air balloons.

title: An Act Concerning A Climate Change Related Surcharge On Certain Insurance Policies.
description: To enact a surcharge on certain insurance policies for fossil fuel related facilities that contribute to climate change.

title: An Act Concerning Park Replacement By Municipalities.
description: To clarify certain provisions of the park and open space replacement statute for municipalities.

title: An Act Concerning Jurisdiction Over Farming Occurring On Certain State Lands.
description: To transfer oversight of farming occurring on certain state lands from the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection to the Department of Agriculture.

title: An Act Concerning A Grant Program For Wildlife Rehabilitation Facilities In The State.
description: To establish a grant program for certain nonprofit wildlife rehabilitation facilities in the state.

title: An Act Concerning The State's Bottle Bill.
description: To (1) require the development of a product stewardship program for beverage containers sold in the state, (2) examine the legal implications of requiring state-specific labeling for beverage containers sold in the state, (3) establish a timeline for the picking up of beverage containers by distributors, (4) prohibit transshipment of beverage containers, (5) require the acceptance of certain processed beverage containers by distributors, (6) make permanent certain escheat distributions from beverage containers, and (7) prohibit the act of short bagging by redemption centers.

title: An Act Designating Various Days And Months.
description: To designate various days and months.

title: An Act Concerning The Secretary Of The State's Recommendations Regarding The Circulation Of Primary And Nominating Petitions And Distribution Of Absentee Ballot Applications.
description: To prohibit for a period of time certain individuals convicted of crimes under title 9 of the general statutes from circulating primary and nominating petitions and distributing absentee ballot applications.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of Whether Unclaimed Gift Certificates Should Be Considered Abandoned Property.
description: To require the Treasurer to conduct a study of the feasibility, advantages and disadvantages of having unredeemed gift certificates escheat to the state.

title: An Act Concerning Political Spending And State-granted Corporate Powers.
description: To (1) prohibit any corporation formed in this state, and any foreign corporation doing business in this state, from making any political expenditure unless such political expenditure is made from a political committee established by such corporation, and (2) modify the corporate powers that the state may grant to entities incorporated in this state.

title: An Act Establishing The Office Of Government Oversight.
description: To establish the Office of Government Oversight to investigate fraud and waste in government.

title: An Act Concerning Security Of Election Administration Processes, Elections Sites, Election Workers And Electors.
description: To (1) establish prohibitions on certain conduct, including the possession of a firearm or deadly weapon, at or near certain elections-related locations, (2) impose criminal penalties for harassment of election workers and tampering with or unauthorized sharing of election equipment, and (3) allow for Attorney General involvement in matters relating to subpoenas, warrants, other requests and alleged interference with elections.

title: An Act Studying Compensation Of Election Workers During The Early Voting Periods Preceding And On The Day Of Elections, Primaries And Referenda.
description: To study the compensation of registrars of voters, town clerks and other local election workers during the early voting periods preceding and on the days of elections, primaries and referenda.

title: An Act Concerning Exploratory Committees.
description: To (1) restrict exploratory committees to not more than thirty days of operation, (2) cap the maximum contribution to exploratory committees at two hundred fifty dollars, (3) limit the total amount of contributions exploratory committees may receive to five thousand dollars apiece, and (4) provide that, if a candidate makes any statement that such candidate is exploring a run for a particular office, such statement triggers the requirement to convert an exploratory committee into a candidate committee.

title: An Act Concerning Vexatious Requesters Under The Freedom Of Information Act.
description: To include harassing and threatening conduct that occurred outside of a request for public records under the Freedom of Information Act when finding a person to be a vexatious requester and to permit a longer period of relief from requests from such vexatious requester for a second or subsequent granting of a petition.

title: An Act Concerning Observation Of The Conduct Of Election Recanvass Procedures.
description: To afford election recanvass observers greater ability to observe the conduct of election recanvasses.

title: An Act Concerning Contracts With Nonprofit Human Services Providers.
description: To require the Secretary of the Office of Policy and Management to conduct reviews of the level of services and reporting requirements of nonprofit human services providers and to require prompt payment of private provider organizations.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The State Contracting Standards Board.
description: To implement the recommendations of the State Contracting Standards Board, including requiring a notice of bidder rights in solicitations, requiring minimum staffing for the board, amending what is required for privatization business cases, permitting waiver of bidding requirements for minor, nonrecurring or emergency purchases and expanding disqualification grounds.

title: An Act Concerning The Legislative Commissioners' Recommendations For Technical And Minor Revisions To The Government Administration Statutes.
description: To make technical and minor revisions to the government administration statutes.

title: An Act Concerning The Use Of Apprentices On Prevailing Wage Public Works Projects.
description: To create phased-in requirements for the usage of apprentices on certain prevailing wage public works projects, and to subject contractors and subcontractors who do not comply to a civil penalty and temporary disqualification from public works contracts.

title: An Act Concerning The Electronic Surveillance Of Employees.
description: To require employers to notify employees of where electronic surveillance is occurring and which prohibited activities may give rise to surveillance without prior notice.

title: An Act Concerning The Revisor's Technical Revisions To The General Statutes.
description: To make various technical changes concerning grammar, clarity, accuracy of internal references and consistency in the general statutes.

title: An Act Concerning The Provision Of Annual Training To A Person Appointed As A Conservator In A Probate Court Proceeding.
description: To require the Probate Court Administrator to establish and implement an annual training program for persons appointed as a conservator in a Probate Court proceeding.

title: An Act Concerning Judicial Branch Operations.
description: To make various changes to the general statutes (1) governing Judicial Branch operations, processes and procedures, and (2) affecting civil and criminal proceedings.

title: An Act Concerning Visitation Policies Of The Department Of Correction And The Transfer Of Funds Held In Trust By The Department Of Correction To Persons Who Were Formerly Incarcerated.
description: To prescribe (1) minimal in-person visitation thresholds for persons who are incarcerated, and (2) the process for the transfer of funds held in trust by the Department of Correction to persons who were formerly incarcerated.

title: An Act Concerning The Failure To File For Certain Grand List Exemptions.
description: To allow certain persons to file for property tax exemptions, notwithstanding certain statutory deadlines.

title: An Act Concerning Consumer Safeguards For Long-term Care Policies And Administration Of The Connecticut Partnership For Long-term Care.
description: To establish consumer safeguards for purchases of long-term care insurance policies.

title: An Act Concerning Oversight Of Federal Fund Applications By The Department Of Social Services.
description: To allow legislative oversight of applications for federal funds by the Department of Social Services.

title: An Act Targeting Fraud, Waste, Abuse And Corruption.
description: To deter fraud in the supplemental nutrition assistance program and include federal officials among public servants subject to state laws concerning corrupt practices affecting the Medicaid program and other state programs.

title: An Act Establishing Financial Safeguards For Private Equity Ownership Of Nursing Homes And Prohibiting Required Arbitration Agreements.
description: To establish financial safeguards concerning private equity ownership of nursing homes and to prohibit nursing homes from requiring residents or prospective residents to sign arbitration agreements to resolve disputes.

title: An Act Concerning Legislative Oversight Of Medicaid Waivers, Medicaid State Plan Amendments And Other Federally Funded Programs.
description: To establish additional legislative oversight of applications by the Department of Social Services for federal funding.

title: An Act Establishing The Crime Of Digital Forgery.
description: To establish the crime of digital forgery.

title: An Act Concerning Distracted Driving And The Safe Operation Of A Motor Vehicle In A Highway Work Zone.
description: To (1) include the playing of a video on a mobile electronic device that is in full view to the person who is operating the vehicle as a form of distracted driving, and (2) specify that distracted driving in a highway work zone is a violation of the state's reckless driving statute.

title: An Act Concerning A Technical Change Concerning Government Organization.
description: To make a technical change to a statute concerning government organization.

title: An Act Implementing The Recommendations Of The Department Of Administrative Services Concerning Criminal Background Checks Of Employees With Access To Tax Records.
description: To require criminal background checks of employees with access to federal tax records be conducted at least every five years.

title: An Act Concerning The Use Of Fiscal Intermediaries By State Agencies For Payroll Services.
description: To require state agency contracts with fiscal intermediaries for payroll services to provide for financial penalties in the event that the fiscal intermediary fails to timely process payroll.

title: An Act Implementing The Treasurer's Recommendations For Revisions To The Unclaimed Property Program And Second Injury Fund.
description: To make various revisions to the unclaimed property program and Second Injury Fund recommended by the Treasurer.

title: An Act Making Technical Changes To Statutes Concerning State Contracting.
description: To make technical changes to provisions concerning state contracting.

title: An Act Concerning Online Political Donation Platforms And Limiting Automatically Recurring Contributions.
description: To (1) exclude certain voluntary payments given by contributors to online political donation platforms from the definition of "contribution", and the use of such online platforms to request such voluntary payments from the definition of "expenditure", and (2) prohibit such platforms from taking automatically recurring contributions without the affirmative consent of contributors.

title: An Act Concerning The Secretary Of The State's Recommendations For The Implementation Of No-excuse Absentee Voting.
description: To implement the Secretary of the State's recommendations for implementation of no-excuse absentee voting, including provisions regarding (1) removal of the statutory restrictions on absentee voting, (2) distribution of absentee ballot applications, (3) use of a single envelope and other aspects of returning absentee ballots, (4) ability to cure absentee ballots in cases where voters have not signed the statement on the return envelope, and (5) tracking of absentee ballots and applications throughout the process.

title: An Act Concerning Security Of Public Officials And Employees.
description: To (1) amend the Freedom of Information Act to provide that public agencies may not disclose, from their personnel, medical or similar files, the residential addresses of certain public officials and employees, (2) permit candidate committees to expend campaign funds for personal security services, and (3) (A) establish a "legislative safety account" from which the Joint Committee on Legislative Management may expend moneys for purposes of state legislator and state legislative staff safety, and (B) provide for funding of such account.

title: An Act Making Technical Changes Concerning Elections.
description: To make technical changes to statutes concerning elections.

title: An Act Concerning Recommendations Of The Bipartisan Prescription Drug Task Force.
description: To set term limits and administrative support for a prescription drug task force, require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to expand the Strategic Supply Chain Initiative to include efforts to prevent or mitigate prescription drug shortages and require the Commissioner of Social Services to negotiate more supplemental prescription drug rebates.

title: An Act Concerning Long-term Care.
description: To expand the scope of study of long-term care needs.

title: An Act Concerning Hospital Uncompensated Care.
description: To expand hospital financial assistance to patients and reimburse such assistance in a voluntary assistance program.

title: An Act Protecting Food Security For Veterans And Others And Mitigating Federal Cuts To Nutritional Assistance.
description: To mitigate federal changes in the supplemental nutrition assistance program with a transitional assistance fund, expand food security with a Medicaid waiver program and increase rates for meals on wheels providers.

title: An Act Protecting Paychecks For Personal Care Attendants And Expanding Public Access To State Programs.
description: To require contractual safeguards for personal care attendants working in self-directed home care programs and accessible communication by state agencies and private organizations contracting with state agencies.

title: An Act Concerning Medicaid Rate Increases.
description: To increase Medicaid rates of reimbursement in accordance with a study.

title: An Act Concerning A State-funded Caregiver Program To Assist Parents Of Children With Autism Spectrum Disorder.
description: To provide a state-funded caregiver program for parents of children enrolled in a Medicaid waiver program.

title: An Act Concerning The Complex Rehabilitation Technology And Wheelchair Repair Advisory Council.
description: To amend statutory provisions and requirements concerning complex rehabilitation technology and wheelchair repair.

title: An Act Concerning Discretionary Transfer From Juvenile Court To Adult Court.
description: To include all serious firearm offenses in the list of offenses eligible for transfer from the juvenile court to the adult court, require a motion to transfer a hearing on such motion for a case involving such offense to be within fifteen days of the child's arraignment and require reporting on transfer motions.

title: An Act Concerning Sentencing Of And Parole Eligibility For Individuals Whose Offense Was Committed When Such Individual Was Under The Age Of Twenty-six Years.
description: To expand provisions concerning the sentencing of a child who committed a class A or B felony and parole of persons who committed a crime under the age of twenty-one years, to those persons who were under twenty-six years of age when they committed such crimes.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of The Criminal Procedure Laws Of This State.
description: To study the criminal procedure laws of this state.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of The Laws Of This State Concerning Issues Of Criminal Justice.
description: To study the laws of this state concerning issues of criminal justice.

title: An Act Concerning Criminal Penalties For Intentional Damage To Critical Infrastructure.
description: To strengthen criminal penalties for intentional damage to or tampering with critical infrastructure and public safety systems by expanding the offenses of criminal mischief in the first and second degrees to include conduct that causes damage, or creates a risk of interruption or impairment of services rendered to the public, including utility, transportation, communications, emergency response and other essential state and municipal systems.

title: An Act Concerning The Correction Advisory Committee.
description: To make technical changes to the statute establishing the Correction Advisory Committee.

title: An Act Concerning The Suspension Of An Operator's License For Repeatedly Failing To Stop For A School Bus.
description: To suspend the operator's license of a person who has repeatedly violated state law requiring a motor vehicle to stop for a school bus that is displaying flashing red signal lights.

title: An Act Concerning Address Verification Reforms For Registrants.
description: To make a technical correction to the definition of "sexually violent offense" and modify provisions concerning verification of a registrant's address and other information and associated penalties for failure to do so.

title: An Act Concerning A Study Of State Revenue Policies.
description: To require the Commissioner of Revenue Services to study the revenue policies of the state.

title: An Act Establishing Municipal Growth Dividend Payments.
description: To establish a municipal growth dividend distribution program.

title: An Act Establishing The Connecticut Growth Investment Fund.
description: To establish the Connecticut Growth Investment Fund as an alternative to the tax imposed by section 12-391 of the general statutes.

title: An Act Concerning Structural Efficiency In The Collection Of State Revenue.
description: To modernize state revenue collection of payroll expense through an employer administrative optimization program, establish a structural efficiency dividend to be applied to the reduction of public benefits charges on electric bills and provide for the enhancement of employee retirement assets through qualifying retirement investment plans.

title: An Act Concerning Community Partnership Opportunity Agreements.
description: To establish a community partnership opportunity program and agreement framework to expand educational achievement and workforce skills in communities experiencing persistent economic disadvantages.

title: An Act Concerning The Connecticut Workforce And A Productivity Gap Surcharge.
description: To require the Secretary of the Office of Policy and Management to (1) submit an implementation plan that includes a workforce and productivity gap surcharge on employers to recapture lost revenue from displaced employees while providing a permanent tax exemption for increased productivity achieved through the augmentation of a stable workforce using collaborative technology, and (2) adopt policies and procedures to implement such plan if the General Assembly fails to enact such plan by July 1, 2027.

title: An Act Concerning The Redemption Rate And Refund Value Of Beverage Containers.
description: To provide for the reduction of the beverage container refund value and for reimbursement to deposit initiators for certain losses resulting from overredemption if the Commissioner of Revenue Services determines that the redemption rate for beverage containers exceeds one hundred per cent for calendar year 2026.

title: An Act Conveying Parcels Of State Land To The Town Of Branford.
description: To convey two parcels of state land to the town of Branford for fair market value.

title: An Act Amending A Conveyance Of A Parcel Of State Land In The City Of Middletown.
description: To amend a prior conveyance of state land in the city of Middletown to clarify what use of the parcel is required and require the Shiloh Baptist Community Development Corporation to repay any mortgage granted on said parcel in case of its reversion to the state.

title: An Act Amending A Prior Conveyance Of State Land To The City Of Bridgeport.
description: To amend the cost of a parcel of state land previously conveyed to the city of Bridgeport.

title: An Act Repealing A Conveyance Of A Parcel Of State Land To The Town Of Canton.
description: To repeal special act 24-20, which required the conveyance of a parcel of state land to the town of Canton.

title: An Act Conveying A Parcel Of State Land To The Northwest Resource Recovery Authority.
description: To convey a parcel of state land to the Northwest Resource Recovery Authority for purposes of operating a public transfer station for municipal solid waste and recycling materials.

title: An Act Conveying A Parcel Of State Land To The Town Of Killingworth.
description: To convey a parcel of state land to the town of Killingworth.

title: An Act Conveying A Parcel Of State Land To The Town Of North Canaan.
description: To convey a parcel of state land known as South Greenway in the town of North Canaan to said town.

title: An Act Conveying A Parcel Of State Land In The Town Of Easton.
description: To convey a parcel of state land in the town of Easton to The Congregational Church of Easton, Inc., for purposes of open space and two small butterfly gardens-pollinator pathways.
